body: The Royal Botanical Gardens in Peradeniya, Sri Lanka is not to be missed. It is a beautiful place! The trees and flowers are amazing. It is so well cared for. The birds are everywhere and are adding to the peacefulness by all their singing.
title: The Royal Botanical Gardens in Peradeniya , Sri Lanka

body: The way the gardens are done up is spectacular. Went with children so we hired a buggy and went around. Amazing landscape and beautiful scenery to be seen. Amazing to see so many orchids in the orchid house
title: Amazing

body: Wide variety of plants and trees often famous for the dignitaries who planted them. Good selection of orchids in the hothouse. Long periods of walking but there is a mini train that works as a hop on/ hop off bus.
title: Royal Botanical Gardens

body: A wide range of plants many of which have been planted by dignitaries from all over the world. The orchids are spectacular. The whole area is well kept and is a great place to spend a relaxing afternoon.
title: Kandy highlight

body: A very nice place to visit for an interesting and relaxing few hours. Great cafe. Hot house was wet and a good place to cool down.
title: Wide variety of plants and wild animals

body: The rain didn’t spoilt our visit here, when we spent a few hours in these beautiful botanical gardens. Impressive orchids and awe inspiring trees and flowers. So many gardeners keep this place immaculate. But I will never forget the hundreds of huge fruit bats hanging in the trees! When they took to flight ... it was scary!
title: So much to see in so little time... but those fruit bats!

body: The Botanical Gardens are definitely one of the highlights of a stay in Kandy. If you are short of time take a 1 hour tour in a golf buggy with a local guide (1000 rupees) The guy we had was incredibly knowledgeable and showed us all sorts of plants and birds that we would have probably missed by just walking around on our own. The fruit bats high up in the tree tops are fascinating. Many of the wonderful trees have been planted by visiting dignitaries and our guide knew the date everyone was planted.
title: Beautiful and a brilliant way to spend an afternoon!!

body: This was by far the highlight of our stay in Kandy. The gardens are stunning and there are so many plants and trees to take in. We enjoyed watching the fruit bats hanging from the trees. If you don’t have much time I would recommend prioritising the gardens.
title: A must visit

body: The gardens are huge, so there was a lot of lovely spaces to walk around and see. There were also these huge bats which were pretty cool.
title: Lovely Gardens

body: We visited the Botanical gardens in Kandy yesterday morning. We hired the golf buggy for one hour and were taken around the gardens by a guide who was very informative. We stopped and looked whenever we wanted to which was good. One of our group walked around but couldn't see all the gardens in that time therefore missed out on certain parts of the garden. We were short on time and apparently you need four hours to walk around the whole gardens. They are certainly worth a look at even if you don't have four hours. There is also a bus which takes about ten people.
title: Beautiful gardens

body: Located in Peradeniya, just 5.5km to the west of the city of Kandy and is renowned for its collection of orchids. The garden is home to more than 4000 species of plants, spices, medicinal plants and palm trees. You can explore the grounds on foot, however, if you’re feeling tired, or potentially lazy, golf carts can be rented. It costs 1500 LKR/person to enter the gardens. A perfect place to relax and take some great pictures, we spent about 2 hours here and went early in the morning to avoid crowds of people.
title: Beautiful and relaxing

body: This garden serves as both a leisure park and a biological resource. It is popular but huge. It is located a short distance out of Kandy but travel is slow. It is largely open but there are areas of shade. Plants are largely well labelled. A good map is provided. Polythene is not permittedTh Royal Palm walk is splendid but there are many other interesting features. The orchid house is interesting and colourful. Dont miss the Javanese figs with their huge roots. Dont miss the numerous fruit bats in the northern area. There is quite a lot of birdlife too.
title: Fabulous space

body: A visit to the Botanical Gardens should be at the top of your To Do list here in Kandy. It’s worthwhile paying for a buggy ride around the Gardens as there is much to see and the guide will point out many things you might otherwise miss. It’s also hot, so the breeze as you drive is refreshing.
title: You must do this while in Kandy

body: This botanical garden should not be missed on a tour of Sri Lanka. Such a amazing place and has wide varieties of plants. Well maintained. Air was fresh, nice and cool in the morning and very relaxing. A must do while you are in Kandy.
title: Overall a wonderful experience.

body: We decided to Visit the botanical gardens during our whistle stop tour of Kandy. We were not disappointed!! By far the best thing we did in Kandy. The gardens are a complete contrast to the busy city centre. Huge open spaces, very quiet and peaceful.... just don’t look up!!!!! About halfway through walking round/through the gardens, we looked up only to see 1000’s of bats the size of cats in the trees. Despite being harmless, it can be a little intimidating.Strongly recommend to anyone visiting Kandy. This has to be on your list of things to do.
title: Amazing contrast

body: You must see this place when you go to kandy , amazing, wonderful place and it was one of the places i really like, big trees with alot of roots, all kinds of tree.
title: Just wow

body: Well worth going and spending half day here. There are less flowers in the gardens than I expected and the gardens are dominated by large trees, with some particularly impressive specimens. There are also large collections of Bamboo and palms. There is also a reasonably nice orchid house.I think I was most impressed by the large number of flying foxes (bats) that roost in the trees in the corner near the suspension bridge. There are thousands, and the information board says 24k which I can believe. They make quite a racket, and you do see quite a number flying around which is impressive as they are huge.One minor critism is that there were too few benches, and those that were available were always occupied by courting couples, it seems to be where they come.Overall a great place to spend a few hours, although not in the same league as other botantical gardens such as the one in Singapore which is a lot bigger with a vastly superior collection of orchids.
title: Pleasant place to spend half day

body: Overall a wonderful experience. Calm and serene, this garden shows some amazing plants, trees, and flowers. The orchid garden was particularly beautiful.
title: Orchid Garden

body: It was great to spend a few hours wandering around the gardens. There were a number of school groups at the gardens when i visited and one group took great delight in meeting me and having selfies.
title: An oasis

body: They may not be the greatest gardens you'll ever see but as we had a morning to fill in, a nice long walk through the gardens was perfect before continuing on our road trip through Sri Lanka. For once we didn't have our heads buried in a guide book, we just roamed and discovered as we went, including a very nice cafe that made VG coffee.The gardens are big and nicely laid out, another legacy of the British Colonial era. The air was fresh, nice and cool in the morning and very relaxing.
title: Chill Out Time

body: We only had an hour to enjoy this immaculate haven but we could have stayed for much longer. Every part of the garden was excellently kept. The highlights we found included the massive bamboo trees, the Orchid House and the Flower Garden. We were here around midday and found it to be very hot. I would recommend visiting at a cooler part of the day to really be able to take everything in.
title: A gardeners paradise is

body: Well worth spending a couple of hours here as they are truly lovely. The orchid house is especially nice but the collections of bamboo, the herb garden but mainly the general fantastic layout of the garden. A must do while you are in Kandy
title: Beautiful gardens

body: I had been really looking forward to visiting here and it did not disappoint!Beautiful trees, flowers, gardens, orchids and lots of opportunity to spot wildlife and birds. We arrived morning and walked anti- clockwise and found it very quiet as most people seemed to be going clockwise, I especially loved the walk down cabbage patch lane. Highly recommend a visit but take plenty of water, it is very hot!
title: Superb!

body: I have visited the "Royal Botanical Garden" twice and like to see again and again. There are so many local plants, trees and foreign plants also. Very attractive place is the Orchid Garden, you can see so many Orchid flowers in it. I would like to thanks the staff of toilets cleaning, because they doing their job very well and so many cafes also are there. Recommended for full day or half day-outing trip here.
title: Beautiful historical garden.

body: These botanical gardens are so pretty. You just cant stop admiring nature. But the weather these days is so so hot. It ruins your trip. Better to take a buggy ride all around the park, else you might not be able to cover it all. Start late in noon so its some nice stroll. The bamboo plantation is just mesmerizing. Some very old trees, some trees planted by royal guests, spices trees area and a suspended bridge are some highlights where you should stop. P.s i was so amazed to find really clean restrooms!
title: Lovely place

body: Amazing trees and rare species. Good collection of orchids. Too bad we did not had a guide to explain the plants in the medicinal garden. Restaurant is very good. I recommand it.
title: A nice piece of nature experience

body: we visited the garden today and found a truly amazing collection of plants and trees. If you want to spend a half day or more that is no problem. Al the trees and plants are well marked. And there are flying foxes in the trees near the river. it's all well maintained and beautifully made. A must do when you visit kandy
title: wonderful garden near kandy

body: It really is tourist friendly as advertised with delicious food and drinks at very reasonable prices overlookingthe gardens andwhen I was silly enough to walk away without my bag they locked it up and returned it with a smile when I returned 20 minutes later!
title: Tourist friendly cafe in Peradeniya botanical gardens Kandy

body: You can cheat and spend 250rupees on taking an electric car around the main areas, but it pays to walk because you see so much more, including the large colony of flying foxes hanging from the trees. The garden is full of delights and everything is well signed in English.
title: 147 acres of well kept gardens

body: My tour guide took me here @l was not disappointed very large area so we took shuttle tour the quide explained all the trees plants very informative l loved the orchid house ask grow orchids back in Australia highly recommend you won't want to miss this one while in kandy
title: Garden visit

body: Lovely gardens to stroll around or even take a picnic. Some really beautiful rare trees all nicely labelled with good descriptions of what they are used for. A lot are medicinal and still used in medicine today. The orchid house is really beautiful unfortunately when we were there it was very busy so try and time it so you can have a really good look around at these beautiful plants.
title: Lovely gardens

body: For us this was the highlight of our visit to Kandy. The gardens are excellent. Beautifully laid out, well documented and surprisingly peaceful.They compare very favourably with Kew and those in Madeira. You do not need to be heavily into gardening or a botanist to enjoy these gardens - just relax and walk.One word of caution. It can be very hot, though there is a lot of shade. Take plenty of water, or, if the heat is problem, use the buggy for a guided tour.
title: One of the best we have seen.

body: Great day out with my clients. It was very peaceful and relaxing to walk around. You can hire a buggy there itself if you want to see it all within limited time.Tickets can be purchased at the office.Wonderful gardens immaculately maintained with a superb orchid house, plant house and green houses. The information was very clear and everywhere. Countless fruit bats. The baby monkeys are adorable! Set up in 1821. If you like huge mature beautiful gardens and parks .....you will love this place...It’s like an oasis of fresh clean air and wide open spaces in a busy city. Highly recommend you to visit and to have lovely couple of hours if you will go to Kandy.
title: “Absolutely beautiful”

body: This is a beautiful location to visit on a warm, sunny day. It is a moderately large park so one has the option of having a great walk but there is also a shuttle bus that moves from one important part of the park to another (at an added cost above and beyond the price of entry). There are many amazing sections including imported species of trees and flowers from other parts of SE Asia and even South America. The orchid building is wonderful to visit, albeit it a little hot and humid. There are a large number of bats in the trees as well as birds. A very peaceful place to visit after the intensity of the surrounding city.
title: Lovely park and botanical gardens

body: We visited late in the day and foot sore from earlier excursions so took a buggy with a knowledgeable driver,which was not very expensive. A vast range of plants and trees in well organised sections, well worth a visit to experience another side of the busy city.
title: Beautiful Gardens

body: Very boring place in Kandy. It’s a normal garden for most of the people, however it is heaven for plant lovers as they can find variety of trees and flowers over here. Nothing to do here and you will find lots of local couples romancing behind the trees. Also you will find lots of local school students coming for a day picnic here. Fees is too high for visitors which 3000 Rs for a couple. Entry to a garden with nothing to do is very high. Moreover there are buggies operating in the garden but again at a very high cost and their availability is very low. You will have to wait a lot for your turn.Not a worthy place to visit! Avoid if you can!
title: Very boring place | Only for hardcore plant lovers

body: Really beautiful park, with loads of of trees (some really uncommon), flowers and animals. Was able to spot a few animals, such as bats (in huge number), squirrels, snakes and birds. Probably the best attraction in Kandy area.
title: Really beautiful park

body: We thought we may spend a couple of hours here and ended up leaving 4 hours later. It has a vast array of species from all around the world growing. There are plenty of toilets, cafes and restaurants scattered around to keep you hydrated. There is a shuttle bus available at a small cost if you get tired of walking. There are signposts well placed to find your way around but I found it a little difficult to follow the supplied map which came following the 1500 LKR entrance fee for foreigners.
title: Expansive Gardens

body: We had a lovely morning tour of botanical gardens and Orchard house. We had a cart that made visiting easy. We stopped as necessary. We even saw monkeys. The orchards were beautiful. I also like the gift store and the vendors waiting outside!
title: Beautiful Garden

body: There are lots of tropic trees and flowers from all over the world. Very nice place to be away from the city noise. Spend 3.4 hours there.
title: Beautifull garden

body: This type of visit is generally not to my liking, so I was pleasantly surprised to have enjoyed it quite so much. It was included on our Tour itinerary, but I believe entry was about £7 equivalent & well worth it. A tranquil place, despite the large number of visitors. We saw the fruit bats in flight, visited the Orchid house, saw the tree plaques with plantings by many famous personages etc. Our guide was very knowledgeable & this enhanced the trip. Depending on your level of interest, one could spend most of a day here.
title: Quite Fascinating

body: We spend a couple of hours here at the end of our day that started in Dambulla and ended in Kandy, and they were a thoroughly enjoyable couple of hours. If we hadn't told our driver to come back in two hours we might have stayed a little longer, but I think we saw most of the highlights.The orchids are of course fabulous, but to me the most impressive were the tress with plaques showing who had planted them and one. I must say the future Czar Nicholas II did a great job, as did Edward VII while Prince of Wales.You wouldn't miss a great deal by skipping the suspension bridgeMy one regret was that we were too early to see the flying foxes, and I failed to find the trees they were roosting in. You wouldn't think 24,000 of them could hide so wellLots of rather sweet young local couple walking round holding hands
title: absolutely beautiful. And not that expensive despite the whinging on here from some

body: These are very well organised and set up gardens. Some very interesting specimens, and thousands of flying foxes fruit bats (24 thousand apparently). There are regular small bus tours around the grounds which would be worth taking, or simply stroll around yourself.
title: Lovely gardens, worth a half day visit

body: Loved this wonderful place. Best thing of all was the golf cart we rented to get around as it was punishingly hot. The guide was knowledgeable and pointed out trees planted by notable people. The orchid house was the highlight but we also liked the three palm lined avenues and the lake. It was so quiet and calm here.
title: Serene Oasis

body: It's nice to see this beautiful and old Garden. Full of tree, and nice park. It's a place for walk and relaxing, maybe one of the best place in Kandy...
title: Very calm place

body: The entrance fee for tourists is 1500 rupee each, and they give you a map of the walks and locations of plants.There are free toilets, water points, and shops inside selling food and drinks so don’t panic if you aren’t prepared.The whole place is amazing and has such wide varieties of plants. You can get lovely photos like on Instagram at the palm tree walks and the large open green is great to sit in the shade part way through your walks and get your energy back for the rest.We leisurely walked around and stayed inside circa 2-3 hours, but if you were very interested I’m sure 4 hours would be plenty.There are TUK TUK drivers outside, as ours didn’t want to wait, but please note they will ask a premium to get back to Kandy but we just asked a few and one was wiki f to take us back for 300 rupee rather than 700.
title: A beautiful walk

body: Excellent visit with a private guide extremely knowledgeable and interesting.It is a must when in Kandy. When in the garden must visit the orchard house, well presented with many species.
title: A must

body: The gardens are very well looked after and are beautiful. The fruit bats in the trees were great to watch. the range of species was vast and the whole gardens very well planned. There is a super grass area which local school children were using. There is a good cafe/restaurant and plenty of clean toilets. A really good day out.
title: Wonderful gardens

body: Get out of the noise and madness of the city and spend a wonderful couple of hours wandering these lovely gardens. Stunning flowers, awesome giant bamboo and the orchids are breathtaking.
title: Beautiful peaceful walk

body: If you are in or close to Kandy and have a few hours to spare I'm certain you won't regret a visit to the Royal Botanical Gardens, which having visited once I'd return again and again, if I ever had the chance. At the time of writing this there are nearly 4,500 reviews on TA so I'm certain I can't add anything new.There's so much to see and enjoy, and as well as plants we also managed to tick off a couple of new bird species which we'd never seen before, although surprisingly we didn't see any fruit bats ( perhaps we were just in the wrong place or at the wrong time).The only congestion we experienced was in the orchid house, elsewhere there's 60 hectares to roam, so space for everyone.Highly recommended.
title: So pleased this place was on our Itinerary

body: We visited this beautiful botanical garden on our way to Nuwara eliya from Kandy on a morning. It was very calming experience and got the chance to identify lot of new plants most of them native to Sri Lanka. it was a well maintained park where you can go and spend the time relaxingly. lot of space for children to run around and have fun. However, try to visit in a morning and on a less crowdy day.
title: A beautiful place

body: This Royal Botanical garden is really beautiful. We were there for about two hours which was insufficient. Allow as much time as you can as the grounds are vast. If you are short on time, it might be better to take a guide.The gardens are set in a loop in the Mahawli Ganga (river) on about 150 acres of land but it feels more spacious. Highlights for me: Lovely Orchid house, Royal Palm Avenue, Suspension Bridge, Sri Lankan shaped pond, The Great lawn, the rows of trees planted by visiting dignatories over the years, the fruit bats & the macaque monkeys.
title: An oasis of calm just outside Kandy

body: We visited the Royal Botanical Gardens with friends and thoroughly enjoyed another walk through the beautiful gardens. There is always something new to see every time we go there, including the area of trees planted by famous visitors - King Edward VII and Czar Nicholas II for example.
title: Another excellent walk around the Royal Botanical Gardens

body: I love the peace and tranquility of the Royal Botanical Gardens. The plants, Mameluke and birds help to create a haven of calm amidst the frantic hustle and bustle that is Sri Lankan traffic. For me a must visit.I read people complaining that foreigners pay more than locals. What a good idea, pity we don’t do that in the U.K.
title: A real favourite of mine

body: We visited here yesterday. It was 1500 rupees each and well worth the money. We went in over a suspension bridge which was quite bouncy but there is another entrance if you are not keen on that idea. We felt we didn’t have enough time here as we were meeting our driver and could have happily stayed another couple of hours. There is a cafe and an ice cream place in the centre.
title: Allow plenty of time

body: Approx 20 mins outside Kandy (very busy roads) this is a real treat for those who love gardens, trees, flowers and history.
title: Beautiful gardens with pleasant small restaurant/cafe.

body: Great for nature lovers, should ideally go in the early morning or close to sunset to avoid the heat of the afternoon. Many species of birds, a very large roost of Flying Foxes, lovely gardens intersting collection of fauna - but the relatively poor labelling of the plants robs some of the pleasure of the garden.
title: Wonderful Arboretum and Botanical Garden - poor labelling of plants

body: Park is lovely and peacefull. Do not bother to order sri lankan omelette in cafeteria. U get only bland omelette with few bits of tomato. Asked about it from waitress. They just throwed me a loads of chili on different plate next to omelette. Been in Sri Lanka 1 month and this is definetly the Worst customer experience this far.
title: Garden is lovely but cafeteria crushed experience

body: This is probably the most wonderful botanical garden I have visited. There is a staggering array of trees, bamboos, ferns and colourful flowers from all over the world. Even the huge grassed areas are remarkably attractive. The hundreds of fruit bats in some of the trees are spectacular to see. The orchid house is small but nevertheless very good, although it would help if there were labels identifying the various types. We spent about 2.5 hours here but would have happily spent much longer if time had allowed.
title: Wonderful Gardens

body: When you think ur mind should be calm then visit here will be it’s sure because when you walk you feel the creation of god and the peace of mind
title: It’s always royal

body: There are a range of trees, plants, herbs & flowers. Huge garden for a nice leisurely stroll. Cost 1500 Rupees per person
title: Impressive gardens

body: Wonderful gardens immaculately maintained with a superb orchid house and plant house.Set up in 1821, it has been extended and added to ever since.There are some magnificent trees, both indigenous as well as tropical all set out in extensive grounds. By the river is the extraordinary sight of the flying fox bats with wingspans of over 1mtr.For those at all interested in flora , this is a must see, and a very enjoyable way to spend a couple of hours.
title: Rival to Kew ??

body: We could have spent the whole day here. Such beautiful mature trees, palms, shrubs and flowers and so well kept. There are lots of shad d places to sit down in when you are a bit frazzled with the sun. It is worth going. My favourite was the memorial garden area with trees planted by past and present world leaders and famous figures from history. The flying foxes are also a must-see.
title: Glorious botanical gardens

body: Great day out with my mum, was very peaceful and relaxing to walk around, the greenhouses were beautiful, however not many flowers were outside due to the time of year, so would defiantly come back in summer time to see the flowers. We booked last minute and got discount online so would defiantly recommend booking online! However the orangery restaurant was awful!!!! Would not recommend, floors were disgusting, food was over priced, waitresses looked unhappy, coffee from machine was disgusting and the doors were constantly being left open making it cold inside! So that’s the only bad thing I would say. Overall the gardens were beautiful.
title: Great day out

body: Nice beautiful cool place in hot Sri Lankan hot weather. Natural cools air will full of oxyzen lot of flowers and trees
title: Beautiful tree collections

body: Not normally my cup of tea but everyone spoke to recommended it after a long drive and visit to the tooth temple and tbh I wasn’t disappointed! Very well kept vast gardens with many points of interest and some beautiful floral arrangements !
title: Beautiful

body: We took side entrance using suspension bridge, which was fantastic. At the end of it number of monkeys “welcomed” us. You should be careful though as they are far for being innocent. The botanical garden is a must see in Kandy. It’s calm and relaxing and you can walk around as there is plenty shadow provided by some amazing trees. Entrance fee for 2 adults and 2 children is 4500 Rs.
title: Entry via suspension bridge

body: it was not worth the money, I experienced nicer gardens even without the need to pay. We were visiting on Friday and there were lots of school groups visiting. We expected to have a relaxing walk and sit for a coffee in nice surroundings, but it was not possible. Go only if you have some time to spare and want to stay away from the Kandy city center.
title: not worth the money and too many school trips to enjoy

body: An incredible collection of plant life, small and large, and well worth a visit. Take a hat and plenty of water because it get's very hot walking the grounds, but well worth the effort.
title: An amazing garden

body: Really lovely gardens and huge so you can avoid the crowds that inevitable gather here. Lots of plants and trees to see and learn about but most people engage with the monkeys. There is an amazing colony of fruit bats in the trees by the river. Allow 2-3 hours to stroll around slowly in the heat.
title: Clearly a Kandy must-see

body: Visited as part of a group and the buggy was recommended by our local guide. A great idea as the driver spoke excellent English, was very knowledgeable and clearly loves these gardens. Highlights were the royal planted trees, the palm tree walk, orchid house and the cafe with a cool breeze wafting over the terrace while we had a late lunch and cold beers. Even if you have little interest in botanical gardens do visit. It’s like an oasis of fresh clean air and wide open spaces in a busy city.
title: Hire a buggy if you want to see it all

body: Director-General Dr. Krishnarajah is fantastic. Emptying if garbage cans should be done more frequently. Milk bar at the entrance are staffed by rude locals who are abusive to children. Guy with pony tail was on drugs, or acted like one. They entire staff should be replaced immediately.
title: Afternoon Walk

body: We were on a day tour from the Cinnamon Grand to the Elephant Orphanage and Temple of the Tooth and our guide, Nishantha, suggested visiting the gardens. They were stunning. Unlike NZ and the UK there is no need for glasshouses and we saw many beautiful and imposing plants. The age of the trees is impressive as it is an old park (1371AD). The Great Circle was really interesting as dignitaries over the last 150 years have been planting trees. There was a riot of colour in places, awesome avenues and gigantic bamboos. The gardens are huge (147 acres) and we would recommend paying 250 rupees (2 NZ$) extra and taking the shuttle tour if you only have limited time. You could easily spend a day here and it was a romantic spot for couples.
title: Unexpected Treasure

body: We could easily have spent all day here. Peaceful, quiet but beautiful. The variety of plants is amazing. Originally a royal pleasure garden but laid out by the British in 1824. Look pout for the flying foxes!!
title: Fantastic Variety of Plants

body: The botanical gardens are well worth a visit. Very well maintained grounds. You can take a buggy around however there is no English commentary. A few more English signs on the trees and plants would go over well.
title: Excellent way to fill in a few hours

body: Beautiful gardens just outside of the town, quite large well laid out and easy to navigate , lots of unusual plants and trees with a large poulation of fruit bats at the top end of the gardens. Well worth a trip and easy to spend 3 or 4 hours here. Nice orchid house and a variety of animal and bird life.
title: A little oasis of peace

body: Love this place and keep coming back. Tranquil and calming. Like other reviews I love the fruit bats and just walking through the trees. One big gripe is lack of books or other publications. Asked guy in shop if they had books about trees or the gardens. He seemed to think this was an astounding thing to ask. Would have liked to be able to find out more about what I was looking at.
title: Heaven but not enough information

body: This is a very nice and beautiful garden. It is a pretty large park so the best way to see it is by cart. This takes about an hour and cost is very little. Well worth the visit and a great way to fill in the day.
title: Vacation

body: A great way to escape the manic nature of kandy for a couple of hours. This is an oasis of calm. The gardens are beautifully kept and the fox bats are an experience to see. Lots of deliffirent plants, trees and flowers from around the world are kept here. Just a few things our guide helped with. Always enter and leave via the suspension bridge entrance as it is much quieter, watch out for the monkeys, they will steal anything if you give them an opportunity and take plenty of water. There are places to buy stuff but not a great deal of variety? Worth a visit.
title: Beautifully kept gardens

body: I’m not usually a botanical gardens kind of guy, but we really enjoyed this place and it was a lovely escape from the chaos of Kandy. We spent a couple of peaceful hours wandering around these large beautiful gardens. Admittedly there were a lot of people here but it never seemed busy once we’d left the entrance behind. Lots of different garden houses to visit plus a couple of impressive avenues of palm trees, a picturesque lake and plenty of places to sit and watch the world go by. We also saw a whole lot of bats in some strange leaning trees, I’ve no idea why they were leaning so dramatically. If you need refreshments there’s couple of cafes for a drink. Lovely, peaceful and definitely a good place to wander around if you have some spare time on your hands. Iain, London
title: Beautiful gardens!

body: Wonderful. I really enjoyed seeing the fantastic range of plants. The large colony of bats that are in the trees along the river are fascinating.
title: Wonderful gardens

body: We spent two hours here and could have easily spent longer. Amazing variety of trees, beautifully upkept lawns. This place is used by locals and tourists alike. Entrance fee was 1500 rupees. The park is also home to colonies of fruit bats which are fascinating to watch. If you have the time this provides calm away from the hustle and bustle of Kandy
title: Well worth a visit

body: Spent 3 hours wandering around being amazed at the variety of plants on display. Stunning orchids, enormous bamboo, medicinal plants and loads more
title: Such beauty and variety

body: Loved this place ! so absolutely beautiful.....If you like huge mature beautiful gardens and parks .....you will love this place....Lots of shade but where a hat !
title: Incredible 225 year old exquisite garden !

body: The gardens are huge and crammed with specimens although it has to be said that the bulk are trees and shrubs and these are the main strength of the place. We found the display houses disappointing and lacking in inspiration but there are some really splendid palm-lined avenue walkways and spectacular clusters of bamboo. It’s really like a huge park for which there is a £7 entry fee. There is a local bus runs from Kandy clock tower for 40 rupees and the journey takes about 25 minutes.
title: Lovely parkland

body: These gardens are definitely worth a visit. We spent 6 hours there, and could have spent longer. Great value for money, but regardless of that, there was so much to see, in these immaculately well kept gardens, which were easy to wander around, and a total joy to absorb oneself in. There was a vast array of plants and trees, ferns and spices, and a suspension bridge well worth walking over!. The gardens are set alongside the river, which made for a stunning setting. We travelled by tuk tuk each way which made the entire experience superb and unforgettable.
title: Stunning

body: We went to the Botanical Gardens as part of a two day trip organised by Sam Sampath, Big Brother Tours. Sam had organised a cart and a guide to take us round and I was glad that he did. There is so much to see and a huge area to cover, we learned so much from our guide that we would otherwise never know.The flora is beautiful and the gardens very well maintained. Thoroughly enjoyed our visit and would recommend.
title: Beautiful

body: A very good place to visit as part of the visit to Kandy. We used the electric cart for Lkr 2000 which was worthwhile as the driver was very knowledgeable about the flora and the history. Downside is the poor toilet facilities ( donot even go near them) lack of proper parking facilities.
title: Can use the cart service to get around

body: We thoroughly enjoyed our day walking around these stunning gardens which are beautifully kept. Allow a good 3-4 hours to see everything. There are plenty of seating areas dotted around if you need a rest as well as some picnic areas and a restaurant. We got caught in a tropical storm and used the time to have a lovely buffet lunch in the restaurant for a reasonable 950 rupees per person. It was a very enjoyable day out.
title: Fabulous Gardens

body: An old British era botanical garden- huge and well maintained. You will beautiful well manicured lawns and some exclusive orchid varieties. Some very exotic and rare trees are found here. Ticket is LKR 1000 for adults and 500 for children. Be prepared for some walking. There are electric buggies but not sufficient for the crowd.
title: Worth a visit

body: large , well designed garden with beautiful collection trees and flowers. Especially the tree collection is impressing.I couldn’t see everything as my driver was waiting. Most of all it is very very well kept. next best to me with the « jardins de pamplemousse » on Mauritius.tip : go urly in the morning as it gets stickier around noon
title: stunning

body: We had such a perfect day exploring the gardens, I’d recommend it to anyone who has some spare time when visiting Kandy, so many interesting things to see, including this strange Irish man pretending to be a tree.
title: Brilliant way to spend the day

body: Could have spent a whole day in the Garden as it is just gorgeous. The Garden takes up 147 acres with over 4,000 species. Lots of walking around but I did see a trolley bus. The garden has different areas including the Orchid House, Great Lawn, Lake, Spice Garden (reached via a suspension bridge), Flower Garden and Palm Avenue to name a few all with magnificent plant specimens. It will take a few hours but when you're tired you can sit down on beautiful manicured lawn and rest a while. There's a busy cafe near the Great Lawn but toilets are few and far between.
title: Stunning gardens

body: The botanical gardens are the largest in Sri Lanka, with huge areas of green well kept lawns. There are many different aspects to the gardens which contain specific sections such as orchids, rubber trees, the palm avenue to name a few. Giant fruit bats hang in the trees and fly screeching overhead. There's more than enough to keep you here for a few hours.
title: A must see

body: We spent a very pleasant 3 hours here and covered most of the gardens. The highlight was the fruit bats which were amazing, spread over the left side of the park and in their thousands. The orchids were beautiful and the trees in the arboretum spectacular, huge buttress roots lianas. We had cold drinks at a kiosk and coffee in the cafe, buffet lunch was available. All was good with the exception of 2 gardeners who begged for money.We went on to the 3 temples loop, a nice change to go to sites with only a few other tourists and worth the time.
title: Botanical gardens kandy, Sri lanka

body: There are plenty of nature’s delights here. Firstly, the trees are magnificent and there are so many different species, many are endemic. Secondly, you can see a number of colourful birds here. Thirdly, how about the huge red fruit bats that fill the trees in their hundreds! Not to mention the macaques which roam the gardens looking for scraps. There is also a very good cafe which has good value buffet food. If you need to get back to Kandy when your visit is over, and you are fed up haggling with tuktuk drivers, just jump on the bus and pay a few rupees (around 9 pence). Brilliant place.
title: Beautiful gardens full of surprises

body: There are so many varieties of beautiful plants, flowers and spices. Having the monkeys around makes the experience even better. Highly Recommended.
title: Beautiful

body: a garden with a huge variety of plants, some not even available in other parts of the world. a very enjoyable walk and the gardens even had an orchid flower house with different varieties of orchids.
title: interesting garden with a huge variety of plants and flowers

body: We were taken to the gardens by our guide ‘Obama’. It was a beautiful and relaxing place to visit, except the bangers being set of to scare the fruit bats off! We really enjoyed our time there. The orchid house, the avenue of palms and all the different examples of plants and trees were well worth the visit. We both would definitely like to visit the gardens again.
title: Royal Botanical Gardens

body: A spacious and picturesque escape from the hustle and bustle of Kandy. Take the time out for a pleasant stroll (45-60 mins) around the perimeter, or just sit and enjoy refreshments at the restaurant.
title: Escape the hustle and bustle

body: It was our first attraction visited in Sri Lanka and one that we found with the best value. Great and majestic with a high diversity of exotic trees and plants. Truly worth the visit. I would recommend going in the morning when it's not too hot.
title: Beautiful place

body: These gardens are well laid out, with various sections including orchid houses, perennials, and avenues of various trees. They are clearly labelled so if you like collecting information it is easy to take photos of the notices. A one end of the garden the fruit bats keep up a continuous shrieking. It is quite awesome to see so many of these creatures hanging from the trees. Some of the trees are quite old and have fantastic root structures. This is a lovely way to spend a couple of hours.
title: Amazing gardesn

body: Huge grounds with the most amazing gardebs to easily walk around and enjoy. Lovely orchid house. Watch out for the trees full of bat's at one end. Everyone will enjoy this
title: One of the best

body: It is almost larger than you can take in in one day. I'm glad we went. It was cool to see nutmeg trees for the first time. It was really interesting to stroll under hundreds of roosting bats at the far end of the park. There special environment houses for cacti and orchids. There are many open park areas in which to simply relax and enjoy the surroundings.There are a few pleasant views of the river - and then there is that rickety suspension bridge people stand in line to walk on!But there are few concessions inside the gates and when it got hot, we decided we had enough.
title: Large park with many different areas of interest - but mostly an arboretum

body: I could've spent at least a day here. So much to see and take in. I would've liked the golf buggies to be free to those who need them - or for people at one far end of the garden, trying to get to the other end in 30 degree heat and high humidity! Nonetheless one of the highlights of my wanders in a city.
title: Royal indeed!

body: Visited here on Jan 21st,2019. This garden is more floral than the Hakgala botanical gardens. Plenty of couples and white skinned foreign tourists here. You can also pay extra to sit in a buggy and see the place with live commentary and photo stops by the driver - which we did here. Since it is quite large if you plan on covering it by foot/walk then plan to easily spend at least 4 hours here.
title: Peradeniya plant conservatory

body: Had a great few hours here enjoying the green spaces and variety of trees and plants, could have spent a great deal more time exploring.well worth the visit
title: Visited as part of an organised trip

body: Botanical garden is located approx. 5.5 km before the Kandy city center bordering Mahaweli river. A historical park dated back to 1371 has over 4000 species of plants including some endemic ones to Sri Lanka.Loved exploring rose and orchid gardens but, felt orchid varieties were not enough. But whatever available wad not disappointing. Enjoyed Walking along the two palm avenues and cabbage avenue. There are more avenues, but couldn't try them all. Entire park is approx. 147 acre which may take 1/2 day to cover.
title: Sooo beautiful ! Must Visit

body: Great place to escape the madness of the temple of the tooth.Good place for people watch and the café is a nice location if a bit pricey.Would love to spend more time here
title: Peace and quiet in kandy

body: Its a beautiful and well-organised garden, with some impressive trees. We were there around 2pm and walked for 2.5 hrs. Alot of shade and a good constant breeze kept us cool. We saw lots of squirrels, monkeys, lizards and a few interesting birds. The kids were pretty excited about spotting these. We also took lots of photos and making silly poses. All the trees and shrubs were impressive, and very interesting. The gardens were well kept and quite beautiful, looking like a scene from an European garden. Great walk after lunch and great family bonding too!
title: Beautiful place

body: One of the nicest green spaces i've ever experiencedJust a quick glance at all the trip advisor reviews on here and its obvious the botanical gardens are popular and highly rated.I can only add weight to that and say that we thoroughly enjoyed spending an afternoon here, though you could spend a full day if you had the time. We were contemplating just having a rest day round the pool at the hotel but decided to make the journey here and we were SO glad we did.Other places should look to this place as an example of a well thought out, maintained and looked after urban green space.It contains a bewildering variety of plants and trees, giant fruit bats hanging from and flying between the trees, monkeys you can get right up close to, lakes, and an orchid house with some of the most amazing flowers.There is a cafe / buffet restaurant in the park, but this would make a lovely place to bring a picnic.If you appreciate and enjoy nature and green spaces then this is a must visit if staying in or near Kandy. It is approx. 15 mins from Kandy city to here by tuk tuk and the fare should cost about 5 GBP. If you have already been on a tuk tuk with a mad driver then you will understand what an 'experience' this is, and if you haven't then do try to experience this at least once in your travels !
title: One of the nicest green spaces i've ever experienced

body: A great place to visit just outside Kandy. 15000 rp entrance but beautiful grounds, incredible trees and plants. Good bird life and flying foxes galore. And the cafe just outside the entrance is cheap and good.
title: Beatiful

body: A great place to visit, interesting trees, flying foxes, according to the guide 24,000 of them, a lake, an orchid house and just a really peaceful place to stroll. We could have spent longer here but really enjoyed the visit. If you in Kandy it is a must. Entrance is 1500 rupees.
title: If you are in Kandy do not miss these gardens

body: This place is amazing! I love plants and animals and visiting the beautiful gardens was perfect for me and my husband! You can see a lot of flowers, many types of trees from different parts of the world, friendly monkeys, big bats in the trees and many more. We also loved the orchid house. At the end of our visit, we stopped to the souvenir shop and bought incense sticks and some other local goods for our family and friends.
title: Perfect day out at Royal Botanical Gardens

body: Very large garden located about 6km away from the city centre (~6 km; 20 mins by tuk tuk). Ticket prices: 1,500 Rs (adult), 1,000 Rs (student. They accept international student IDs). Takes about 2 hrs to go through the garden. Clean, beautiful and great variety of different gardens and plant species. Would highly recommend for those seeking some serenity away from the hustle and bustle of the city.
title: Beautiful garden

body: Enjoyed a full day in these splendid gardens and still didn’t see everything. Highlights included the incredible mahoganies with their extraordinary roots, the cannonball trees whose flowers are so delicate, the talipot palm with an unusual life cycle and the gracious avenue of palms. Good buffet lunch at the canteen and a kiosk for later refreshments.
title: Wonderful gardens

body: These gardens are offering countless species of local exotic flora. My favorite was royal palms, memorial trees and house of orchids but that is just a tiny part of what you can run into there. Reserve few hours and about about 1500lkr for this large area that is an ideal place for walks and relax.
title: Large and beautiful gardens

body: This is a lovely tranquil place in a very busy Kandy. The gardens are really well maintained. There is an area with fruit bats in loads of trees, an orchid house and a very scary looking suspension bridge. The gardens are really worth a visit.
title: Lovely huge gardens

body: A beautiful place to spend a couple of hours away from the hustle and bustle of Kandy... giant bamboo... lakes..monkeys and bats. So big it can’t really be crowded... calm and tranquil
title: A beautiful place

body: This is a very nice botanical garden, with many beautiful flowers in the garden, and a great collection of orchids. There is a pleasant relaxed atmosphere, and we could easily have spent more time there.
title: Beautiful garden - worth a visit

body: This park is gorgeous! It's one of my favourite places in the world because it's extremely beautiful and very well-kept. Plus, if you enjoy being in contact with nature, I'm sure you will love spending some time here!
title: Extremely beautiful

body: Visited here while on a tour of Sri Lanka. What an oasis of calm and tranquility! Some very impressive tree lined avenues and many fabulous specimen trees.
title: Fabulous!

body: We visited on a very hot day and there is not a lot of shade. Allow a couple of hours and go on the suspension bridge for photo. The orchid house is amazing there is such a variety of plants and trees. The fruit bats were interesting to see and we also saw lots of monkeys. Definitely needs to be on your itinerary when visiting Kandy.
title: Beautiful Tranquil Gardens

body: Impressive collection of Trees from all over the World. A pleasant afternoons' diversion from the mayhem of downtown Kandy. The tree collection is quite spectacular. The Orchid House the Rose Garden etc were a little disappointing. That said I have never seen such a range of tree specimens. The Palm avenue and the Giant Bamboo trees are awesome. Well worth a visit for a couple of hours. More interesting than Kandy itself
title: Interesting , a wide selection of trees - More Trees than Plants

body: 200 year old royal botanic garden with a huge variety of flora and fauna to see. TIPS: thousands of bats live on the island, so if you are lucky (or loom long enough, you will definitely see and hear them. unique experience. I would suggest to plan 1.5 hrs. Garden tours on electric gold vehicles are also on offer for those who cant walk long
title: Beautiful gardens - must see for nature enthusiasts

body: A beautiful tranquil oasis of greenery and colour amidst the noise and traffic of downtown Kandy. What a calming place to visit after a hectic day sightseeing in the urban area.With exotic species of all kinds plus butterflies and birds that really is too much to do and see in one visit. Highly recommended.
title: Stunning scenery.

body: Not somewhere we would normally go but had a spare afternoon and made a visit. Very glad we did, beautiful and extensive gardens full of extraordinary trees and specimens. Need at least a couple of hours to explore - suspension bridge over the river, fruit bats flying about and hanging down/dripping from the trees for the night, fascinating canon ball tree and many more surprises.
title: Amazing Trees!

body: If you are in Kandy you must go to the Royal Garden, it's amazing, you can have a picnic in one of the parks, have a nice walk through the day and enjoy the shade with the breeze. Just one advise, in one of the paths, there are a lot of bats so be careful when you walk through that part or avoid it. They don't do anything but just in case you are afraid.
title: Lovely!

body: This is quite a large botanical garden and takes at least 2-3 hours to walk around. It can also be quite hot as there are large sections of lawn that are unshaded. It's a nice place for a wander, and the orchid house, although not overly large, is really, really good. There's a cafe in the middle if you want to stop for a rest and cold drink.
title: Pleasant botanical gardens (with a lovely orchid house)

body: Really beautiful gardens. Plenty of space to walk around and relax.Very green and lots of places to stay and enjoy the silence. We have seen many amazing specimens. We enjoyed very much the Cook's Pine Avenue.
title: Lovely and beautiful gardens

body: One of the best maintained botanical gardens ever visited. If you are interested in the plant life scientifically , or just want to spend some good time in middle of best possible flora, this is the place to be. It's huge, so keep at least 3 hours to be spent here. Secondly, follow the map strictly, else u can easily lose track of places visited. Involves a lot of walking, so not recommended for very young kids. They also have an option of hiring golf cart, but not sure about the prices.
title: Huge, wow, great, worth visiting

body: Really nice vast garden lots of interesting trees from all over the world. The garden is home to 24,000 bats which can be seen hanging from the trees, breathtaking. There are also monkeys in the garden as well as a suspension bridge over a river which can be walked on. There is a lovely buffet that can be had for lunch as well.
title: Lots of plants and Lots of bats

body: Slightly outside of Kandy with a not cheap entry price,especially for those that are accustomed to free access to parks, but well worth a visit. Wonderful place to while away several hours in a generally peaceful and interesting environment. There are lots of plants that were impressive (and a huge herd of bats) and that we’ve not seen before, and also interesting installations. Bring water - it gets hot and only some parts have shade. Lots of picnickers too. There is a shuttle that goes around as the grounds are really large.
title: Exceeded expectations

body: Worth spending at least two plus hours here. So many interesting trees. Lots of wide open space, a wobbly suspension bridge at the back and free range monkeys.
title: Vast

body: Royal Botnical Gardens in Kandy is the most beautiful place in Sri Lanka. It appears you have entred a dreamland with beautiful flowers all around. A must visit during your Sri Lanka trip
title: Breathtaking!!!!

body: The royal botanical gardens are beautifully maintained and we have a chance to see so many different varieties of trees and plants from different parts of the world. The kids had a great time there and there was a beautiful lake shaped like Srilanka. We got to see different palm varieties and the double coconut tree.
title: Calm and beautiful

body: Very well maintained gardens with beautiful flowers and trees. A very pleasant afternoons walk around this large estate,
title: Superb large gardens in the City

body: I will begin by saying that I've been to more than my share of overpriced attractions in Asia. This garden, if you are a fan of gardens that is, is worth the 1500 LKR entrance fee. The place is absolutely huge, rubbish free, and very well maintained. I wandered around for 3 hours and could have spent longer there. I've certainly seen better collections of specific types of plants, but the overall collection on display here, and the overall feel of the place was special. One minor criticism - I would have loved to see an orchid display 10 times the size of what they currently have (think Singapore's garden). You know they grow here, let's show them off! The day I visited there were dozens of students on a school assignment mingling among the foreign visitors, engaging them in conversation as they practiced speaking English. It was refreshing to see their enthusiasm and I was more than happy to take time to chat with them.
title: Worth the Price

body: Really surprising Gardens, some of the best maintained and constructed gardens....the collection of fig trees are awe inspiring!
title: Great Gardens

body: A beautiful large park and gardens in the heart of the city, well worth a wander through. We only got an hour and would suggest a bit longer, we were rather rushed. Some fantastic trees and flowers especially the orchid house, well worth the entry fee.
title: Tree,s and flowers to impress

body: The park is a haven of peace and serenity against the otherwise manically busy city of Kandy. Ensure that you visit in the morning, its cooler then and with less people. It is exceptionally well kept and the information about the trees and plants rife. We were further excited to spot, within the arboretum, several clusters of the biggest bat's I have ever seen in my life, so Mrs Johnson was delighted to be able to capture them on camera. A very beautiful park.Couple of down sides: I had hoped that here I would be able to escape the constant £ sign that seems to hang over every tourists head in this country, within the tranquility of the trees. Oh no. Security guards popping over for a quick chat, but swiftly requesting a cigarette to further irradicate their foul, bleeding gums, another chap digging a flower bed bent my ear, all be it politely, about his excellent hobby of collecting foreign currency, very clever, and to top it off, when spotting two brilliantly bright white bovine beats in a clearing, so of course stopping to oggle, their minder pops out from behind a tree and starts jibbering about rupees. Highly annoying.Further, and my wife thinks I am incorrect in moaning about this, but the incredibly inflated price that a tourist pays as opposed to a local. Yes an average Western tourist is going to have more money, but oh my giddy aunt, the backlash that would ensue if the British charged 22 x local price to wealthy Sri Lankans or indeed any other tourist, to enter into Kew Gardens. We would be called racist, accused of defiling the parks good name and no doubt be obliged to make it a fair price for all. The park management have got this wrong here, leaving a bitter taste.
title: Beautiful tranquility in busy Kandy

body: Before I share my experience, I would like to say that this attraction as almost every attraction in Sri Lanka is exuberantly priced by the Sri Lankan government in no proportion to equal attraction in other parts of the world. This especially stands out when the average monthly salary is about $300USD. The gardens are beautifully kept up and are very nice a peaceful, especially since it is set in the busy traffic of Kandy.Go the bridge it is a lot of fun! The orchids are nice although the selection is not impressive.This is a great place to do a bicycle trip although I don't think that this is possibility. Entrance price is 1500 local currency, no discounts available.
title: Very Expensive

body: Sure worth the high entrance fee, inside the garden you find whatever tropical plants and trees that you don´t have to be an arborist to appreciate. Easy to miss is the spice garden - pls don´t.
title: Crazy, lovely and peaceful

body: We visited this beautiful botanical garden while we were in Kandy and it was a great fun for our kids. It is a vast area with lots of spaces for the kids to play. They loved it. And there were lots of tropical trees and plants which we have never known before. Some are only remaining in this park and some are of medicinal value. Wished if we could have spent the whole day here. Must visit if you are in Kandy.
title: A Great place to be with the children

body: Huge Botanical Park with a great variety of trees, plants, flowers, and more. Clean, tidy and very beautiful. Perfect place to take a walk or to go on a picnic. I would definitely recommend it to anyone.
title: Clean, tidy and very beautiful

body: It's a very clean and beautiful Garden. It takes more than 3-4 hours to see it all. There are so many kind of trees and plants - a great biodiversity. I loved to see the palm trees and the bamboos. You will find a lot of monkeys that won't let you eat (especially bananas) - they will come to bag for your food :)))). In one side area of the garden, there are also a lot of noisy bats (the "flying foxes" bats) - too bad you cannot see them flying (they are only flying after the sunset).
title: Great biodiversity

body: Spent a couple of hours here exploring the gardens. Bring water because it can get quite hot. You need the map they give out to get around. Enjoyed another cold drink at the café.
title: Very Nice Nature Day

body: A beautiful garden and lots to see. V calm and many monkeys and different species of plants and trees.
title: Gardens in kandy

body: We are not really the type of family that wanders round this type of place but we all enjoyed it. Very nice for a stroll and a great place to chill from the city chaos.
title: Very Good

body: What a wonderful experience to walk around these magnificent gardens with such amazing established trees. It is a must do experience in Kandy. A pity tourists get stung for admission but it is worth it. Suggest avoiding the cafe in the gardens as the food is pretty average.
title: Almost as good as Singapore

body: We had a lovely day here walking round looking at all the different trees & plants etc. We spotted a few different types of birds. There was also so many fruit bats which was amazing to see! One of our highlights when visiting Kandy, definitely worth the short journey there (25 min from sacred tooth temple)
title: A must do whilst in Kandy for beautiful large gardens

body: Definitely worth a visit if you are staying in Kandy! Although the gardens are slightly outside the centre there are plenty of tuk tuks available to take you there (we paid 500lkr each way). Entrance cost 1500 lkr per person. The gardens are lovely and peaceful which came as a welcome break from Kandy’s hustle and bustle. There are a huge selection of trees and flowers and plenty of wildlife too (large bats and monkeys everywhere!). The cafe provided sandwiches and drinks at a good price. Easily spent a couple of hours wandering the grounds.
title: Beautiful and Peaceful

body: Personally I'm not really a person who gets all that excited about visiting Botanical gardens but as we'd heard so many positive things about it we thought we should visit and so glad we did. Its so vast, peaceful and beautiful - and a welcome break from the hustle and bustle of downtown Kandy. We spent several hours here and loved it - I'm a convert! There are also golf buggies available for those less mobile.
title: Yes!

body: Truly impressive gardens, that are a peaceful retreat from the hustle and bustle of Kandy city. The range of international species and the design of the gardens is outstanding. Consider taking a picnic, and take plenty of water. The cafe does not offer much in the way of food choices, and the restaurant is one of those dreadful buffet style affairs. There seemed to be limited seating around the gardens. We went on a Sunday and the few seats were taken by rather sweet couples, enjoying some quiet time together.
title: Spectacular gardens

body: We popped in for a walk and chill In the peaceful and beautiful surroundings Could have stayed longer but worth it even for an hour Stunning settings
title: An hour well spent

body: This place was 120 acres of amazing gardens. Tropical plants and trees. Very well kept place. We walked around then found a quiet spot to read a book and enjoy the Beaty and ambience. Great clean toilets. Probably the best place in Kandy if you ask me!!
title: Spectacular gardens. Better than anything in Australia

body: The bat colonies here is amazing. Thousands of fruit bats hang from banyan trees. They block out the sky when they fly in herds. It's like inside a batman movie.
title: Highlight is the bat colonies

body: Great place to visit for a nature tourist. Including over 4000 plants including medicine, orchids, palm trees Etc
title: Nature

body: Great things to see around every corner and welcome shade for the hotter parts of the day! The gardens are clean and well maintained. Well worth a visit if you need a quiet couple of hours.
title: Wonderful gardens

body: Do not be put off by the word "botanical". This is a beautiful parkland. We would recommend hiring a guide and also a buggy which in our case was a necessity but even so our tour lasted over an hour. The history of british monarchs can be traced here with the planting of trees to mark their visits. There is so much of interest, trees, flowers, butterflies, birds, insects, amphibians, fish..... and our guide was so informative. Well worth at least a half day visit. The only downside was being ripped off by the tuc tuc drivers.who wait outside. We were charged 1500 rupees for a journey that should have been 500. Walk away from the gates and pick up a driver down the road. The tourist board could help by printing an approximate fare list. Geraldine and Frank
title: Park

body: We were hesitant to visit this garden, as we were disappointed with the botanical garden near Nuwara Eliya. The royal botanical gardens, however, are just incredible. They are so vast that you can easily spend 3 hours there. The 1,500 entry fee for foreigners seems justified as you get to see such a big variety of flowers and tropical trees and on top of it all get to see lots of monkeys, fox bats and water buffalos. There are many, huge green spaces where you can just relax or have a small picnic.
title: Beautiful trees, plants and wildlife

body: The Royal Botanic Gardens are a Must-See for any nature lovers or To escape the noise and grime of busy Kandy. Peradeniya is 15-min tuk-tuk Ride from Kandy. The grounds are expansive, there are paths and walkways and special exhibit houses for orchids, Cactus, bamboo gardens and more. The Orchid House was my favorite.
title: Wonderful, Must-Visit For Nature Lovers

body: This is a must visit site when in Kandy. Very relaxing garden with plenty of different types trees, flowers and other interesting plants etc. Good reserve around 2-3 hours for the visit.
title: Must visit

body: I had been there for two times and this is my third visit. Every time when i visit Kandy i never forget to visit this garden to have a nice realxing break. I saw beautiful varities of flora they are truely amaizing. People try their best to keep it clean. I recommend this garden for you to have a visit while travelling to Kandy. Love it!!
title: Truly amaizing

body: Kandy i personally love that place, people are very kind and environmental surroundings Garden look perfect and calm but some couples are ruin that place coz people come to watch flowers and trees and enjoy the garden not to watch couples. Please act like responsible people.other than very nice place for family.
title: Lovely morning

body: Locals pay 60rpTourist pays 3000rp ($30)Very pretty inside if you like plants and trees. Lots of people and monkeys. I wouldn't go back.Try it, you might like it!
title: Tourist tax strikes again!

body: Definitely worth a visit. I spent a beautiful 2 hours walking around the perimeter of the gardens, so much to see and so beautifully set out.
title: Loved the Botanic Gardens!

body: It is a place where you can spend a beatiful 3 hours and really enjoy in nature. It is meticulousy organized and well mantained. Bring a blanket to lay down on some of big lawns and relax.
title: Definitely a place to visit!

body: I used to ride around these gardens when I was a child in the late-1960s and early-1970s. You can't do that now and it's best to hire an electric cart with a guide who can tell you about the plants. Apparently these gardens were first established by a King of Kandy in late-1300 AD. When the British colonised the country they established the Royal Botanical Gardens in 1843. The gardens occupy about 150 acres and are maintained immaculately and meticulously which is great. I spent about an hour because I didn't have time, but I think you need about 3 hours to explore every part of the gardens.
title: Stunning botanical gardens with historical significance

body: Pleasant walking through all the massive trees. Map was useful. Even though there was a lot of people there it still felt as if you were on your own at times which was lively
title: Worth a visit

body: If you go to Kandy, make the time to visit these gardens. We entered via the suspension bridge (rather than the main entrance) which is worth doing as it is a nice walk across the river into the gardens. Visit the orchid house, see the monkeys, see the bats (flying between the trees and hanging from overhead branches), and enjoy the peace of this tranquil place. I reckon you could lose a couple of hours here and it would be a great location for a picnic. The area is very well kept and a pleasure to walk around.
title: Beautiful Gardens

body: It has something for all year round - they have a beautiful rose garden which we did in Sept., we saw the bulbs in Feb., we saw the rock garden in spring & summer - we bought a 'grandparents' pass so we can bring in kids plus 2 other adults when we go so that this is out go to place for out of town visitors, on baby-sitting days sometimes we take our grandchildren & they like the exhibits as well as the jungle gym playground that tires them more than us but we make it our last stop then home - it is 30 minutes from our home which is perfect for us but well worth a trip on its own from farther afield
title: WE LOVE THIS PLACE SO MUCH WE GOT A YEARLY PASS!

body: It was more than i expected from a botanical garden! Delicate, pretty, well orgnized and definitely worth a visit！
title: Very delicate and many amazing spots

body: This is an interesting garden with variety of orchids, seasonal flowers & trees . Beautifully kept . Needs lots of walking around. Difficult to move if you have toddlers or children.
title: Charming Garden

body: It is a big garden but the collection we expected was not there. The orchid section was excellent, rest portion not properly maintained. Entry fee is excessive, for srilankan it 60LKR but for others it 1500LKR which looked high in compare to the collection of varieties but you can pass few hours there because the area is large. Cactus section is small. I can say just nice.
title: Good but not Excellent

body: Even if you are not into gardening, this is an amazing place. It's a huge site with some amazing plants and trees. It really is worth spending an afternoon here. Well worth the money.
title: Amazing, wonderful

body: An absolutely gorgeous garden. Cafes inside with food and drink. You can rent a golf cart to travel around if you want to avoid walking.
title: Absolutely beautiful! Don’t miss it.

body: It was a beautiful garden and very well maintained. Although it was very busy when we wen there ( I think it was a Saturday), we still managed to find some quite places to enjoy the wonderful flowers and trees.We only had one and a half hours to visit and unfortunately we did not get to see everything. I think you would need about 3-4 hours in order to see everything and not rush.Also, the main entrance is usually really busy so you can take the second entrance and go past the bridge to enter. That one is not that busy. If you go over the bridge, and are afraid of heights be advised that this might not be a thing for you. The bridge is pretty long and goes over a river. Also, sometimes the guard lets kids go on the bridge til the middle and then come back. Naturally, the kids will jump and swing the bridge and also, block the way. All in all a great experience. Would have loved to have had more time though!
title: Beautiful!

body: This is a few km out of Kandy but well worth a couple of hours. Its quite large but is beautifully kept, very well laid our and plants well signed. A family of monkeys can be seen near the palm trees beyond the lake; many beautiful birds also. The northern part is an arboretum with many tress planted by heads of state and other famous figures, starting with the Prince of Wales in 1887. The orchid house is absolutely beautiful. Nice cafe overlooking the Great Lawn. One of the highlights of our Sri Lanka tour
title: Superbly maintained, one of the best

body: Botanists will love this vast garden paradise, as it's filled with a diverse and well organized garden. Most of the locals visiting here come as couples, seeking benches and shade for romance.So if you're a tourist with deep interest in plants, you'll find a wealth of resources. More casual visitors can enjoy the beauty of the flowers and a beautiful and peaceful setting. I highly recommend the orchid house for its exotic beauty.
title: For Flower Lovers and Lovers

body: I love royal botanical garden at peradeniya with very beautiful greenaries around the me.very nice land of the heaven.
title: Amazing

body: Our (Sri Lankan) tour guide used these gardens as a lunch stop: unbelievable ignorance. I went hungry and went on a very fast hour's walk around the periphery and wow, was it worth every minute. Their map plus frequent helpful signposts reassured me that I'd find the way back to the entrance, which I did in exactly the hour, most of which time the rest of the party spent waiting for and eating their sandwiches. Around the gardens I met the unbelievable rainbow Eucalyptus tree with its trunk of many colours; cannon ball trees with their scented pink flowers and hard ball fruits; tall fat conifers, Durians, giant bamboos and so on. Most plants have labels and the whole gardens are curated equal to anything in the UK.
title: A botanist's dream and also very beautiful

body: We were not much impressed by the Botanical Gardens, which we found to be not much more than just a nice, quiet park. We spent no more than half an hour there, then a bit more time in a cute Laksala shop and a surprisingly good coffee shop (both of the with good ac) located inside the park, close to the entrance.
title: Just a nice, quiet park, not much else..

body: Royal Botanic Gardens, Peradeniya are about 5.5 km to the west of the city of Kandy in the Central Province of Sri Lanka. It attracts 2 million visitors annually.The garden includes more than 4000 species of plants, including orchids, spices, medicinal plants and palm trees.Attached to it is the National Herbarium of Sri Lanka. The total area of the botanical garden is 147 acres (0.59 km2), at 460 meters above sea level, and with a 200-day annual rainfall.One needs at least half a day to trek the whole area. The weather was good. For people, who can’t walk, battery operated car is run for a fee.
title: Nature in it’s abundance

body: It's a really great place to get away from the busyness of Kandy. We jumped on a local bus (20lkr ok.) And got dropped off right at the gate. Great walk through the gardens, palm avenues made the biggest impression on me :) watch out for the restaurant, check your bill very thoroughly!
title: Amazing!

body: The botanical gardens are very nice and great to wander around. Be careful in the restaurant; they add drinks to the bill and fold it in such way that you can't see that they added something.
title: Nice garden but watch-out in the resto

body: The gardens cover a large area so you could easily spend several hours here looking at the plants and trees. The highlight for us was the wild monkeys who we watched for ages playing in the trees. There is also a suspension bridge over the river which is worth a crossing
title: Beautiful gardens

body: Having lived opposite Kew Gardens in London we are used to a high standard, Peradeniya was up to this standard.Well organised, an interesting selection exhibits, orchid house, fernery,bamboos, plant house and my favourite the palm avenues.Towards the end of the day, as usual, there was a thunderstorm...
title: Remarkable Botanic Gardens

body: Friendly guide from staff of visitor centre Peaceful walk Heaven in the centre of the city centre I visited in late Nov Guess the gardens will be more beautiful in 2 weeks time and in autumn
title: Peaceful n beautiful gardens

body: Great place to relax, stroll and enjoy the beautiful and unique botanicals. Also a place to get away from the hustle and bustle of the city of Kandy and enjoy and get lost in the lush surroundings of the plants, trees and flowers. Since we were short on time we opted for the quick or the shotenened version of the tour approximately over an hour via a Golf cart rental which runs a reasonable two thousand rupees. The tour consisted of the visit to the orchid house, walking the suspension bridge, spice garden and numerous other areas of importance. The guide was experienced in traversing through the enormous garden and took the time to explain the flora its origins and history. It was a great way to learn and enjoy in a short period of time of what the garden offers to visitors. Great and enjoyable trip where we gained valuable knowledge about botanicals. What we clearly observed in each corner was people tending to plants, flowers and grounds and taking pride in carefully ensuring that the garden is kept neat and tidy and to maintain a pleasing and aesthetic look and feel.
title: Beautiful Garden with unique plants, trees and flowers

body: We could of stayed here for the rest of the day, so so much to see, we kept getting lost which we found funny, we came across a blind dog, which brought tears to our eyes. The gardens were amazing for all to see. There are so many different variety’s of plants to see here. You must not leave Sri Lanka without seeing this place.
title: Amazing garden

body: These are beautiful gardens with a wide variety of plants. It’s a great place for a stroll with lots of shady areas to escape some of the heat.
title: Relaxing place for a stroll

body: its a very huge place and need a one day to cover up all. i couldn't believe that kind a places is exist . welldone sri lanka
title: Orchid

body: Good lung space to relax and exercise. Wide variety of plants and trees. But the entry fee is too high, especially for foreigners.
title: Variety of flora

body: Lovely gardens with beautiful big trees and gorgeous plants of all types. Colourful flowers, shrubs, hedges, trees, all you would expect in a botanical garden. Lots of walking paths, some along the river and also a great little suspension bridge that goes across the river. Lots of seats to take a break as well as a cafe and toilets.
title: Lovely place to relax and escape the heat and hustle and bustle of Kandy.

body: We really enjoyed wandering around these well maintained gardens for a couple of hours. It was especially pleasant after the hustle and bustle of the temple area. The orchid house alone was worth the visit - a beautiful display of colour! The cafeteria by the ‘great lawn’ was very reasonable for a welcome drink
title: Worth the entrance fee

body: Quite big, requires a lot of long walk. But worth the ticket price. Start early and avoid the heat. Tall trees to shrubs , from across the world. Variety of species which are beyond description. Must visit attraction if in Kandy.
title: Wow place

body: After a long period of non-stop rain, we headed out to the Botanical Gardens in a tuk tuk with our fingers crossed that it wouldn't be a complete washout. The place turned out to be far better than we'd have dared to hope.The entrance fee of 1500 rupees (about £7) for foreigners is not cheap - but nothing in Kandy worth seeing seems to be cheap. I would say though that it was absolutely worth it.The site is enormous with a spectacular diversity of plants and trees and lots to see and do. The map was a bit rubbish as it didn't really suggest any sensible way to tackle the gardens, so we just blundered about a bit, saving the orchid house until last and focusing first on the outdoor areas just in case the rain came back.We had lunch at the cafeteria beside the Great Lawn, watching hundreds of children playing tag during their lunch break.
