The food at the cafeteria was surprisingly good value for such a 'captive audience' kind of place - we had a fish curry set meal including soup and fruit salad plus a lime soda each and it was about 2000 rupees for more food than we could eat.The fern house was a bit of a health and safety trap with tools and hoses left out all over the place but everything else was in good working order.We got a bus back to the city for just 20 rupees each after we left. The bus stops are to the left of the entrance. Tuk Tuks were asking 500. Just ask if the bus goes to the clock tower or central market.
title: Fantastic

body: Well worth a visit although the entry price is a bit steep for foreigners - 1500LKR per person. The orchid house displayed some beautiful orchids and there were other lovely gardens, cafes and restaurants and plenty of open spaces and shade. We took around 2 hours to explore and have some lunch, and would have spent more time were it not so hot.
title: Botanic Gardens

body: I didn’t think I would enjoy a walk through a Botanical Garden, especially in the heat but was delighted with our walk around the gardens. Our driver said about two hours would do it we only took an hour and enjoyed it immensely. Not long after walking into the gardens a snake slithered across our path with my husband nearly stepping on it, gave us a fright. The gardens were beautiful and I actually saw several types of trees I had never seen before. The monkeys were different to others we had seen with a big red face. A friendly Gardener approached for a chat and then of course wanted a tip.
title: Delightful

body: Nice place to escape the busy town of Kandy. It was nice to walk around and well maintained. Also pleasant to stop for a cup of Ceylon tea and an ice cream in the tea house. Display houses not so good and man who told us a few things wanted a tip!!
title: Quiet retreat

body: A really beautiful, expansive, well laid out garden. Perfect Eden just out of the main city.Informative reading material and map provided at the ticket office.Pleasant restaurant by the main green for lunch and drinks.We spent a wonderful few hours here strolling along the various avenues of plants and trees.A highlight of our stay in Kandy.
title: Eden?!

body: It’s a lovely garden with maintained place, plenty of interesting trees to see and knowledge.The orchid house is wonderful. There is a shop if you want to relax and have a cup of coffee. You can simply spend 2 hours to cover all the places. I would like to recommend this place if you can walk long if not you can hire a small car inside the garden.
title: beautiful place in kandy!!!!

body: The Royal Botanical Garden is an absolutely fascinating place. Be ready to walk, as it takes at least 2 hours to go around and enjoy the scenery. The gardens are very well maintained and an absolute must see!
title: Fascinating!

body: A very beautifully maintained place, the garden is a very pleasant sight.You can easily spend 2-3 hours just walking around if you want to cover all the spots. The map is very accurate and will help you plan your walk around.If you're looking to go onto the rope bridge, you will have to wait as they do not allow more than 5 people at a time, on the bridge. We were pretty excited about it but gave it a miss after seeing the queue for it.It's a favorite among the locals and you'll see a whole lot of kids, couples, families coming in for picnics, strolls and spending some quiet time.Would absolutely recommend comfortable footwear.The orchids were nothing to die for but decently maintained.Worth a visit
title: Huge place, be ready to walk around!

body: Its a nice garden with lots of interesting trees to see and experience such as, double coconut (never heard of it before), giant bamboo tree, 25 varietes of grass.The orchid house is nice with some very delightful species. However the display is not as tastefully done as one would see in places like Singapore or Netherlands.We had to hire a buggy as I was travelling with my elderly parents who would have found it hard to walk the entire length.With the help of the buggy, we saw the garden in an hour. It was handy to have the buggy (which cost 2000 LKR + 500LKR as tip for the driver) as it had started raining heavily while we were still on the rounds.There is a small gift shop and a barrista coffee place too if needed.
title: Expansive place well maintained

body: If time is short then I would recommend hiring buggy with driver. Buggy seets 7 and costs LKR2000 plus LKR500 tip for driver who doubles as commentator & photographer. It takes 1 hour & allows you to see most of the garden. Particularly useful if weather is too humid.
title: Get a buggy

body: What a find, this is beautifully laid out and takes gardens to a new level, meandering walks, cool breezes, shady oasis and plenty of places to simply stop and smell the air.
title: Just when you think what is so special!

body: Beautifully maintained botanical gardens with various zones for types of plants. We especially enjoyed the orchid house and palm tree avenues. Surrounded by the river on most sides, it was an ideal place for local families as well as tourists and enthusiasts. Highly recommended on a sunny day.
title: Stunning gardens and family park

body: A wonderful and amazing escape to gardens with rich history. Enjoy the surrounds, take a picnic and/or a ball, engage with the locals and enjoy.
title: A beautiful picturesque escape to see some fantastic flora and fauna

body: Good.......Long walking ... Peacefully life ....Greenery.......Fresh air......Peace of mind......green....... atmosphere....... Heaven.....Like Forest.... Double coconut trees ....... Bamboo trees..... squarels sound.....Monkeys.....
title: Good

body: Peaceful park with lots of extremely unusual trees from around the world.Also there are quite a few monkeys about which make good viewing.
title: Nice walk

body: Acres and acres of gardens but way better maintained than most botanical gardens in India. The collection is quite diverse and rare as the signboards suggest. The whole area is very peaceful and calm - not much rush of tourists. Must visit for plant lovers but even otherwise a nice spot.
title: Sprawling gardens with diverse flora in a peaceful environment

body: If you are going to kandy than u must visit this beautiful garden. The views were mind blowing and soo many trees to learn about and beautiful nature.
title: A must see

body: Its big enough that you can feel you are in a hollywood movie where you are sent to a new planet and you have special house for each flowers species. No word and describe the beauty nor pictures can show you how beautiful this planet is.
title: Big Enough

body: Wow...what a collection of plants.I've never been to Kews Garden but believe that this botanical gardens is on par.We were very much overwhelmed the collection here.We spent 5 hours but suggest to spend the day here.Long walks to experience the beauty of this place. It was very eye opening.A must visit place for all botanist!
title: 10 STARS!

body: We had a relaxing time at the Botanical Gardens in Kandy. This is a must visit place if you love Orchid flowers.
title: A beautiful botanical garden

body: This lush quiet oasis in the middle of busy Kandy was an eye-opener. It was hot (as is usual in Sri Lanka) but when you got under the shade of the many trees the coolness was amazing. The highlight though is the orchid house. It isn't all that big but the number, variety and colours of the orchids is just simply stunning. We walked around a lot if the garden but didn't see all of it by any stretch of the imagination. The Palm Grove is so regal you can just see the maharajahs in procession on their elephants!! Don't miss this.
title: Beautiful garden

body: Very well maintained and an eco-friendly attraction. Recommend to visit this early morning to avoid the heat. You can also hire a buggy to take your around the garden. Only con is that is expensive for foreigners.
title: Greenery!

body: The Royal Botanical Gardens at Peradeniya, near Kandy, is worth a visit if you have the time and fancy an interesting walk. There are some majestic old trees and a good orchid house.
title: Good place to walk

body: Nice gardens even in the rain. However DO NOT let your guide persuade you to eat at the cafeteria.It’s really bad and the service is worse.
title: Don’t eat at the cafeteria

body: Got to the gardens went in back way over the bridge great fun. The different types of trees and plant's are just amazing.loads of birds flying round and saw the only snake on the whole trip a rat snake just before the wonderful orchid house.with tortoises in the ponds .a great place to visit
title: Peaceful

body: The botanical gardens, just outside Kandy, are spectacular. A mix of colourful tropical flora and quiet strolls. Very reminiscent of wandering around Kew gardens in SW London.
title: A blooming marvel...

body: Beautiful location... nice stroll around in this beautiful garden- interesting watching the monkeys interacting.... nice time filler
title: Huge open spaces- interesting and well worth it

body: A lot plant houses (eg cactus) were not open to the public.Toilets in the grounds are primitive although thoss in the cafe were clean and western,
title: Sri L:anka vacation

body: The Gardens are probably 5km from Kandy, a short Tuk tuk ride. We spent around 3 hours walking around the Gardens. They are beautifully kept and the Trees are spectacular. The clumps of bamboos add to beauty of the Park as do the plants and the river. In one corner of the Gardens 20 plus thousand fruit bats roost which is a spectacular sight.There are places to take refreshments. I would highly recommend a visit.
title: Beautiful gardens and walk

body: We had a one hour guided tour of the gardens. Our guide was very informative and we loved the beautiful surrounds; magnificent trees and avenues, flowers and lawned areas all beautiful set out. Loved the history and the trees planted by notables such as King George V. Definitely worth a visit.
title: Stunning Gardens

body: You all must visit this location to spend your day , it's very peaceful and beautiful location , kids can play with the environment , the garden is big , if you walk all along the way , it will take 4-5 hours, there are lot of places to take beautiful photos. Skip raining days
title: Enjoy your day

body: We spent a couple of hours here en route elsewhere, but we could have spent far longer! Lots to see and many fascinating and unusual plants, all clearly labelled. The orchid house was stunning, so many different colours and shapes. Wonderful palm walk, and a fascinating “cannon ball” tree! Tranquil areas for wandering, but also lots of grassy spaces for family games and local wedding photos - as it was the weeeknd when we visited, there was lots happening which gave a lovely insight to Sri Lankan everyday life! There’s also ponds, lakes and even a rope style suspension bridge, which gives great views over the river. Sadly the fruit bats we’d hoped to see weren’t in evidence, but it was a very enjoyable visit indeed!
title: Gorgeous gardens!

body: Visited here whilst in Kandy for the day and loved the place. We took a leisurely stroll down the main path to the green, down palm avenue to the suspension bridge, taken in the orchid house on route. Suspension bridge was fun to walk across but not quite sure why there is a gate in the middle with a sign that states stop. We saw some people get to the gate and turn round and then some people got to the gate and opened it and walked all the way across! Then walked along the side of the river and back round to the main entrance. At a leisurely pace this took about an hour.Nice little cafe by the entrance where I enjoyed a great milkshake.Great gift shop with some lovely items reasonably priced.
title: Spent a great morning here

body: Enter the gardens by the back entrance, if possible, so that you can cross the river by rope bridge which makes the experience all the more memorable. The gardens are beautiful and are a lovely place to spend a few hours. In addition to the multitude of plant species there are hundreds of fruit bats hanging from the trees in certain areas. A really pleasant afternoon.
title: Beautiful gardens

body: Spent a couple of hours wandering around the gardens, really quiet even though its in the city, Beautiful flowers and even if you are not a natural gardener it is worth a visit and go for a little walk over the suspension bridge. Also worth watching the monkeys raiding the rubbish bins !
title: Beautiful and Serene place

body: A large botanical gardens given near the centre of Kandy. Would recommend as a way to get some peace in Kandy! It was even possible not to hear the horns when in the middle of the park! There are impressive plants particularly the wild bamboo. Can easily spend a couple of hours.
title: Peaceful in noisy Kandy

body: Simply one of the nicest gardens we have been to. The area is so well covered and the gardens are very big. Lots of wildlife. Take your time just walking around such a great area with fantastic scenery.
title: Great place

body: Poor map is the only downside. However this doesn't take away from the amazing experience here! Lovely scenery and variety! Easy transport links and good value for money
title: Amazing place

body: We were surprised to arrive having to pay an entry fee. Tourist fee is 3000LKR. We enjoyed our walk through the gardens. There are a few paths that are outlined by large palm trees that make for a nice photo. There is also a suspension bridge to go on if you wish which has a nice view of the river. We found that there were minimal benches available to sit on, however this could be due to us visiting on a Sunday where there was a combination of lots of tourist and locals around.
title: Entry fee

body: The Royal Botanical Gardens are beautiful and well worth finding time for if you like parks and gardens. There are monkeys in the park so make sure you have any plastic bags hidden out of view otherwise they will try and take them thinking they contain food. This happened to us but we kept walking, were followed for a bit and then they left us alone. We then hid our plastic bag (souvenirs from a spice garden) from view in a fabric bag we had. It was fine, the monkeys weren’t aggressive so don’t be afraid. We spent two hours there and there was still so much to see.The only disappointing thing about the gardens was the restaurant. It was mainly a limited range western food and the prices were higher than the city because it is a tourist venue. You would expect this. The curry was not available so we ended up having an omelette which came with chips only, and a cheese and ham sandwich which was dry and came with chips and a slightly dry very small salad. The views over the Great Lawn however were stunning.At 1500Rs it is quite expensive compared to other places but it is worth it.There’s a tuk tuk stand outside if you need it.
title: Beautiful gardens to wander around

body: We visited on a hot afternoon and wandered the many paths _ there is a map and many signs so it's easy to get around. There are many beautiful old trees some straight out of Lord of the Rings! The sky turned overcast and in the sudden downpour we sheltered in the Orchid House. The suspension bridge barely gets the adrenaline going but is still a laugh.It would be really nice to bring a picnic and sit out in a shady spot.
title: Beautiful Trees

body: Great day out. The gardens are beautiful, very well kept and lots of different areas. The orchid house is amazing. There was so many different things to see, it took us about three hours to walk round, facilities good, have a lovely lunch in the pavilion. Also there is a suspension bridge which is worth going over. I would highly recommend a trip here for any nature lovers.
title: Fantastic gardens

body: Spend 2 to 3 hours wandering through the gardens. The orchid house, the palm trees and bamboos, lakeside and huge lawns, all in wonderful condition. Clean and well worth a mornings walk.
title: Fantastic, colourful and peaceful.

body: The Botanical Gardens in Kandy are a must visit. Having seen some in India, like the one at Ooty, it is gigantic by comparison. It is exceptionally well kept and cared for. From the enterence to exit , the area is well marked and has excellent species of plants. Do check for timings from local contacts before going. Evenings or early morning are the best time to go.
title: Pristine

body: This is a sanctuary from the delightful chaos of Kandy.Orchards, cactus, herbal garden, palm trees, fruit bats. A stunning array of trees, flowers and grasses. I spent 2.5hours here and I didn’t cover it all! A stunning experience and a must do in Kandy.Toilets well placed throughout park, you’re never too far away from one. Also NB I only experienced this once in the Plant House was a staff member pressuring me for a tip. Otherwise staff were helpful, offered advice and pointed out things of interest without a request for tips.
title: Must do in Kandy!

body: I was there during a sunny afternoon and enjoyed it very much. Make sure you use the entrance with the hanging bridge, much more cooler :) You don't need to be an expert about botanics to enjoy this beautiful garden. Definitely have a walk down the avenue of palm trees.
title: Gem with amazing views

body: There are two entrances to the gardens one via a suspension bridge and the main entrance by Peradeniya University.We came across the bridge which has good views of the river.The gardens are just amazing, beautiful and really peaceful especially when just a short way away is the noisy bustling chaotic Kandy.There are some amazing giant bamboos, cabbage palms that form an avenue, huge java fig, enormous mahogany’s, java almond trees, flower, fern, rose gardens to name but a few.If the plants weren’t interesting enough there are hundreds of fruit bats roosting and flying about with huge wings looking more like something from a long lost era.Also plenty of cheeky Macaque monkeys.It’s just a cracking spot to chill out and take in the wonderful gardens, encompassed by the Mahaweli Ganga river.
title: Paradise in Chaotic Kandy

body: We're not great gardeners or botanists but my two grown up sons, my husband and I thoroughly enjoyed a few hours in this magical garden. Due to the severe downpours, we hired a buggy - what a great decision. Our driver was so knowledgeable and informative and we definitely saw the best of the gardens (as well as having shelter from the monsoon like wind and rain!). Highlights: fruit bats, orchid house, incredible range of trees ... definitely worth a visit.
title: Amazing plants

body: We toured the garden one sunny afternoon and loved it so much, we came back another day to visit the glass houses during a rainy afternoon. The gardens are very well designed and kept. The glass houses are filled with so many gorgeous plants. There are a total of ten glass houses and you could easily spend a couple of hours in them.
title: Spectacular greenhouses

body: Beautiful, peaceful stroll. We spent a couple of hours here, including a meal at the cafe, which was good. Lots of fruit bats at the bottom end, that are on the move throughout the day - if that freaks you out, don’t go to the bottom end. Could have spent longer here.
title: What’s not to like?

body: We loved the garden. It is very structured, beautiful, clean and big. They have signs to give you directions and they provide you with a map. It will take you and hour and half to two hours to go around the garden.It is worth visiting if you like flowers, trees and seeing landscape
title: Worth visiting

body: An exquisite collection of Flora can be found in this vast garden (Vast according to Sri Lankan standards). The Mahaweli river circles these lush garden and there are many old trees and flowers to be found. I for one not much of an enthusiast in botany and all that jazz but I found solace in these grounds among these rare specimens of nature. There are monkeys around, don't try to feed them just observe and report. Buggies are available for the elderly but walking is the best way to experience the park. Can take 3-4 hours to properly traverse the park. There are so many pathways connecting the main trail.
title: A massive collection of Flora

body: visited jan 2017, 20min walk from Sarasaviuyana railway station - has an entry fee (got it in discount because of SAARC price being an Indian national) - you need the whole day to enjoy every nook and corner - There is also a suspended bridge in the premise - A tree full of the nocturnal bats who were almost awake because it was almost twilight - some huge coconuts on tiny coconut trees
title: Massive garden!

body: Quite a stunning set of gardens. We loved it as did the kids. The orchid house is lovely and the palm trees definitely worth a look with the fruit bats screeching overhead. Very lovely.
title: Beautiful

body: There are fabulous botanical gardens about 6 km from Kandy. I have taken a tuk tuk with a cost about 2,000 RPS a / r with (compr. 2 hours waitng) . Entry costs 1,500 Rps, but don't pay with credit card. The cashier told me there was no line and I paid in cash, but after the amount was also charged to me by my credit card company. I have already sent a complaint to my credit card company. Despite this, the gardens are really beautiful. They are very large and it takes 2 hours to visit them . The most interesting elements are constituted by giant bats, flowered park (next to the main entrance) and orchids' greenhouse. Inside the park you will find a restaurant, some kiosks and a coffee shop as well as a gift shop
title: Beautiful botanical gardens. But don't pay with credit card

body: We are keen gardeners and found this to be a beautiful and fascinating place. We were concerned as two of the four of us have difficulty walking long distances these days, but we need not have worried as we notified them and were allocated a very knowledgeable and English speaking guide and an electric buggy to take us to every corner of their many acres. It is a photographer's dream of a place with so many exotic, unique and unusual trees and plants, some of which are centuries old and from all parts of the globe. The orchid house is not to be missed. We spent a thoroughly enjoyable wholechalf day here and woukd be delighted to return..
title: Such a great place

body: As a gardener and plant lover, this was a beautiful and interesting experience. As someone who has done a lot of travel and seen many botanical gardens, I give it a three rating. After all, if you've visited the Singapore Botanical Gardens, you have in my opinion, seen the best you can see in tropical botanicals. The orchids are beautiful and the gardens well worth a stroll (don't forget your hat and water!). Stop off in one of the restaurants for a drink and meal. Plain Western food available for those who need a break from the delights of Sri Lankan flavours. Get yourself one of those plant identifier aps for your phone if you're a true botanist as there are some beauties here!
title: Gardeners Delight!

body: This is s beautifully laid out set of gardens with hot house, tropical house, orchid house at the edges then long vistas of gorgeous Sri Lankan flora, trees, roses, palms and then lovely open parkland. We spent the whole afternoon strolling around, reading the labels and enjoying the day. We visited the on site restaurant and enjoyed the buffet which has great vegetarian dishes all local and some salad. You can order plain food from the menu which is more western. There is a nice gift shop at the park entrance/exit.Reserve 2-3 hours to enjoy this at a leisurely pace.
title: Loved it very much

body: We went to the gardens of the temple of the tooth. Made a wonderful change to the crush of people at the temple. Despite the very heavy rain storm just after we entered we loved the peaceful nature of the place. Huge number of bats and a troop of monkeys only added to the beauty of the actual gardens. The orchid house in not large but some amazing flowers with strange shapes. This is a must for anyone visiting Kandy.
title: Wonderful place to stroll at your own pace

body: I have seen these gardens before, but never had enough time to really explore the lot. So this time I took half a day (some take a whole day,) and... took a golf cart (very reasonably priced I find). One hour, including decent explananations in English by the driver. Then, I walk to my favourite spot, the quiet southeast corner with the magnificent tree roots meandering all over the place. If you can, have a meal on the restaurant terrace (it is quickly booked)Of course, like everything in Sl the price of the gardens go up and up and up (doubles by the time you read it haha). But it is worth the small investement, as this world renowned garden is also prefectly maintained. Something you cannot say about the Uda Watteleke behind the Temple of the tooth. A charming city park, but they could use our dear entrance fee to eliminate the killer vines that threaten this lovely but fragile ecosystem. And about the tuktuks: tried to charge me 5 times the real price (I do know my kilometers and normal price). As the older gentleman insisted I just walked away (some honest drivers still DO exist!). Gent gave me then, a 'reasonable' price (still double, but OK). Had to be dropped off at the very special Waruna's Antique shop - a friend of mine. Tuktuk driver was really angry and tried to lure me to all kinds of 'better cheaper more serious' shops. Internally I just laughed. Was sure it was about commission - which proved to be true ;-))
title: Just a must visit, unique in the world. But... do not overly trust the local tuktuk drivers to get back.

body: Royal botanical garden must be visited if you are at Kandy. It’s very beautiful n have a very large space to slowly admire the nature. The plants and flowers are well organised n maintained. There are wide range of plants. It is a stroller friendly place. Just that it stated to rain half way, we had to go under a tree. The rain stopped within 10 mins.
title: Beautiful garden

body: You will absolutely not regret coming here, whether for the extensive and beautiful floral displays, the perfectly manicured gardens, the luxurious strolling or the ever so slightly scary walk over the small suspension bridge!We also got to see fruit bats and hummingbirds... it really was quite perfect.
title: Stunning Gardens

body: Im a big nature lover and this plact hit the spot.The garden is very organized and clean. It was amazing walking around and seeing over 4000 species that are in the park. In addition to plants i got to see a bit of wildlife also which is also exciting.I highly recommend the visit.
title: Amazing

body: This garden was massive and has a great range of flowers, plants and trees. You'd have to walk a lot, so if you can't I'd recommend you to use the electric cars. The place is a natural spectacle, greeny everywhere, it has a lot of really old and gigantic trees, saw some bats & monkeys around too. Half of the garden is bordered by a river which flows along the garden. The narrow suspension bridge over the river is a must see in this park, definitely a great place for family and kids.
title: Majestic Garden!

body: As a family we enjoy a visit to a botanical garden in a new city we are visiting, if there is one. This one is up there with the best. Beautifully kept, some wonderful species are there. We were amazed to see the flying foxes actually flying during the daytime, so lovely to see. We saw monkeys too. There were separate houses for cacti and succulents and orchids. Only place outside of The Seychelles we have seen Coco de Mer. Nice grounds to sit and have a picnic. A lovely garden in the suburbs of Kandy, easy to get a tuk tuk. I would definitely recommend a visit.
title: Wonderful

body: Royal Botanic Gardens, Peradeniya are about 5.5 km to Kandy.It attracts around 2 million visitors annually.It is near the Mahaweli River (the longest in Sri Lanka).Beautiful Garden with thousands of flower species. It is renowned for its collection of orchids. Can easily spend one full day at Garden.
title: Peradeniya Garden

body: There is a great diversity of plants in the gardens. They are well laid out and maintained. The plan is clear if you want to follow a route and not miss anything, but it would be fine to just wander and enjoy the atmosphere. You do not need to be a keen gardener to enjoy this place.
title: Something for everyone

body: Such a pleasant visit. We were going to skip it out due to time constraints but we are so pleased we came. Really beautiful and clean gardens where you can spend hours. Monkeys roam around too making it a fun experience! Great to escape the hustle and bustle of the city and spend a few hours in the tranquil gardens.
title: Lush gardens

body: Spent 3 hours wandering the gardens on a fairly hot day amongst the chaos of Kandy! Gardens beautifully kept. The thousands of bats hanging in the trees was quite a sight. When we were there there was a local couple having their wedding photographs professionally shot. It’s that kind of place.
title: Beautiful gardens

body: A great botanical garden, full of treasures.There is a restaurant inside the garden which is convenient but average
title: You can easily spend half a day or a full day here

body: Must visit place. Flowers grass Trees . Everything is living. prepare yourself for long walk. Carry umbrella and water. Must do lunch in Botanic garden canteen. Don't forget to charge your camera or mobile you will be taking lot of photos.
title: Nature at its best

body: its worth for your money to visit this beautiful garden. It was highly recommnded by our tour company shanew sri lanka tours.lots of varities of nice plants ,flowers and trees.beautiful landscaping.
title: Worth for Nuwaraeliya

body: Definitely worth an hour or two to wander round these impressive gardens. The map is helpful in pointing out the different gardens and it’s all very well established and maintained. We were also entertained by a troop of monkeys who came up from the river to play in the bamboo gardens
title: An impressive botanical garden

body: An interesting place, with lots of variety and interest, some lovely vistas and reasonably prices eating places. The Orchid House is always a gem, and you will never complain of Bamboo in your garden when you see the size of the ones here. The map allows you to plan your visit and know what you are looking at.
title: Worth a visit

body: As a horticultralist from the UK I take as many opportunities to visit botanical gardens across the globe and this has now been added to the list. A well laid out garden with majority of plants labelled. The labels are red for endemic to Sri Lanka, green for Sri Lanka and India and black for other sources. The suspension bridge is a good experience although the organisation requires some more consideration to keep queues to a minimum. The flying foxes are a true delight although they appear to take time to hone there target practice. The map is detailed and matches to the walkways and the history is a nice touch. LKR 1500 per person, we made it nearly 3 hours and felt this was good value. Well worth a trip but parking can be an issue
title: An enjoyable visit

body: What a beautiful place! There were many different varieties of trees and flowers which were quite unique. It was like walking through an art gallery admiring the breathtaking works of art created by "Nature". I found this to be a refuge of peace, tranquility and serenity filled with many unique sights and sounds. From the monkeys to the hundreds of bats in the trees, this is an experience of the senses! You will be quite delighted basking in the beauty of all you see and hear!
title: Peace & Tranquility ~ Nature's Finest

body: Peradeniya botanical garden is one of beautiful landscaped place. No of different varieties of plants and flowers available. Inside you have very good tea shop.Parking available but lots of vehicle
title: It's nice and green

body: This is a must if you are here.The garden is beautifully laid out.A very good selection of plants.You can spend couple of hours here..
title: Park

body: We thoroughly enjoyed our time here and wished we had more time available to spend there as there is so much to see.You can hire golf buggies to get around, but these can be in short supply during busy periods and you may have to wait a while to get one.The botanical species are amazing and varied, and if you love being outdoors in nature you’ll love this place.Particularly loved the giant bamboo, the orchid house, the Queensland Kauri trees, and the suspension bridge was fun.Can be crowded at times, and plenty of school children visiting when we were there.Definitely worth a visit.
title: Excellent attraction, be sure to include it in your itinerary

body: Everything is good about the botanical gardens: easy to access, easy to move around, amazingly clean and simply beautiful.
title: Wonderful gardens!

body: Quite well maintained gardens. You would need at least 2 hours to do justice to the Gardens. Saw quite a few unusual trees - the Kauri pines were massive.First time seeing the Maldive Coconut palms - huge coconuts. Lots of flowers and greens. Gardens were neatly laid out and the brochure was useful to help us walk about.The Laksadala shop at the exit point was an interesting shop where you can pick up a few souvenirs - reasonably priced.
title: Serene gardens, interesting massive trees

body: Great garden and well liked after. Palms, bamboo and rainforest trees are spectacular. Orchid garden is beautiful. Well worth a visit to escape the madness of Kandy city. Give yourself a couple of hours to wonder around and have a cup of tea.
title: Bamboo Heaven

body: I am not a gardener or even into flowers, but this place was beautiful. Unfortunately there when raining and had forgotten my umbrella so cut the trip short. But huge grounds to roam around in, lots to see.I have never been impressed by orchids until the orchid house here - spectacular colours.
title: Allow lots of time

body: If you need some time for quite and reflection I recommend this place. It is easy to reach from Kandy. If you are into botanical gardens it is a jewel. If you are like me and don’t really have a touch with plants it is still a nice stroll and the suspension bridge is cool.
title: Serene

body: We spent a lovely hour and a half or so just wandering around the beautiful Royal Botanic Gardens in Kandy.It's such an oasis of calm in an otherwise busy city! Loved the Palm Avenue and the Go any Bamboo especially. The Orchid House was very nice too.Plants, trees, flowers and shrubs from all over the world with informative labelling and some nice water features. Beautifully kept lawns, in fact the whole garden is beautifully kept in every way with some nice benches scattered here and about for you to relax on and enjoy the scenery.The suspension bridge over the River gives great views and was another highlight. It only takes 6 people at a time though!A really lovely place about a half hour from central Kandy though graffic is bad at times and may nake it more.
title: Beautiful and Serene

body: If you have only one day in Kandy visit here first. This is an amazing garden, one of the finest in the world. Their collections are spectacular, it’s history is mind blowing, and there is something for everyone. For the thrill seaker they have a suspension bridge. The have palms, cactus, orchids, annual displays for the botanist. For the zoologist Fruit bats can be found here and are delightful. Bring water and sunscreen.
title: Beautiful botanical gardens

body: We quite enjoyed the garden, which is well laid out, quite complete and incredibly maintained. Of particular interest is the orchid display, the medicinal garden and the beautiful annual walkway. Having been to a number of botanical gardens in the past all over the world, this one stands out for the attention to detail combined with a great maintenance practices. It rivals the Singapore Botanical Garden in its diversity and size. What also was impressive was the number of locals coming to visit and enjoy the space. Well worth the visit.
title: unexpected treasure in the middle of the city

body: One of the few gardens in the whole world that got the balance right - natural vs human-intervened, old vs new, flurry of colours vs shades of green, tight spaces vs vast plains, etc. The giant century-old trees mesmerised me. I could have spend the whole day there absorbing the sights, sounds and fragrance if only there were more F&B outlets within the premise.
title: A Must-See especially for Nature Lovers

body: Nice park to be visited if you are in Kandy, good walking gear and some sun protection. Nice collection of different botanical species. Not to commercial.
title: Round trip Sri Lanka

body: Visited in July with the rains on and off... made the place even more beautiful and was picture perfect to click pictures. A lot of walking to do as the buggy’s were not available. Only gripe is the variations in the entry fee... locals are charged LKR 60 and others LKR 1000. Moreover this information is only written in Tamil and Sinhalese.
title: Beautiful park

body: The Royal Botanical Gardens in Sydney are free snd amazingly beautiful. The assortment or trees, plants and birds is fabulous. There is a fantastic view of the Sydney bridge as well as the Opera House. We walked around for hours and I intend to go back.
title: Best botanical gardens I have been to

body: This is the best botanical gardens I have ever seen. It had 36 different areas including double coconut avenue, a massive java fig tree, a great suspension bridge and much more.
title: Amazing experience

body: We strolled around these beautiful and well cared for gardens. This is a calm relaxing place where you can spend as much time as you like. I loved the trees with the crazy root system, they had so much personality.the swinging bridge is cute, orchid house was beautiful, really loved this whole experience
title: Beautiful place to spend time

body: Royal Botanical GardensPeradeniyaWhy go to a crowded tooth temple when you can see thousands of specimen trees in an open space?Not wanting to see yet more temples and relics, nor wanting to see unfortunate chained elephants in an 'orphanage' with attendant commercialism, we went to the Royal Botannical Gardens. It's huge. There would have been too much walking on a hot day so we took a buggy, the driver acting as a guide. He stopped frequently to let us out and admire the trees and planting, and his commentary was informative. We wouldn't have seen half the gardens if walking.These gardens are a match for Kew and Wisley and you can see so many indigenous trees, many in fruit. The avenues are magnificent in ambition of design, the orchids outstanding.There seemed to be a lot of visitors going in but as the place is so big it seemed hardly crowded.
title: Why see a tooth temple when you can see thousands of specimen trees?

body: Absolutely breathtaking place, you can easily spend a few hours there without noticing but The place is a bit run down and not very well maintained,monkeys Everyware. When its sunny, it becomes really hot so don't fogot to carry umbrella and water with you.This is very big botanical garden. Many varieties of trees and plants can be seen here
title: A must visit place if you are touring kandy

body: The outside gardens are well maintained and a great place for kids to burn off energy. The inside exhibits (eg. orchids, cacti, succulents) are uninspiring and not well displayed. On balance this is worth a 1.5 - 2 hour visit.
title: Worth a visit

body: Try to start early in the morning especially coming from Negombo as the traffic jam may be back towards Kandy . I reach there 1 hr before closing due to the massive traffic jam at Kandy. Even for the optional tram ride they want to charge above the retail price as extra tips for their staff due to 1 hr before closing which I rejected. Did not have time to walk the full garden but manage to go their orchard garden and the nearby area.
title: Royal Botanical Gardens

body: Although the entrance fee is steep (1,500), particularly compared to the price for local residents, it is well worth it.Our favourites were the cactus/succulent house, and the beautiful orchid collection with some stunning colours and textures we had never seen before. There is an amazing range of tropical plants and trees imported from all over the world, and the labels are very informative.If you want to save on getting there, hop on a bus going that direction (you can flag any bus down) and it will cost you ten times less than the tuv-tuc).
title: Well-maintained and very diverse

body: A lovely Park worth strolling around. Orchid house was beautiful. Plants generally well marked, with collections from all over the world.
title: Lovely gardens

body: We had gone to Royal Botanical Gardens and the interesting part about this place is that people come here repeatedly to see the flowers as they cant finish it one day. I am sure that even if I was to be there for the entire day, it would take me atleast 3-4 days to cover the entire area. It's beautifully maintained and the grass is well manicured and the attractions of the rock garden is very interesting. We covered the memorial trees and the suspension bridge and it's better to do it all on foot and avoid the buggy at the entrance unless an absolute necessity. SAARC passport holders get a discount on the entrance fees. It's best to carry drinking water and some munchies along if going for few hours but there is a small shop inside for beverages/ packed snacks and there is also a beautiful restaurant insdie. Better still, is to take along a picnic basket and spend time under the shade and enjoy time with nature.
title: must visit while in Kandy...

body: The herbs garden is relatively small but there are so many to see when you are wandering around with lush vegetation. Love the big lawn.
title: A pleasant place to spend a day.

body: If u staying in Kandy do not miss this place it’s very beautiful when u went inside u will see a giant park with many varieties of flowers and giant tress it’s a large area to walk the big giant tress gives u some shades.If u’re going with ur girlfriend,wife or with daughters they will be more happy after seeing the beautiful flowers in the whole garden Good nice place.
title: Walking through big giant trees

body: The garden is located in the Kandy city center and it is kind of MUST SEE. It is a typical English style garden. Variety of tries, shrubs and flowers. You can see also monkies and big bats - they are active during the day. You need 3 hours to stay there. If tired there is a place to have a rest with soft drink, cofee or eat lunch.
title: Wonderful

body: A beautiful place to visit in Sri Lanka. It’s a well-maintained park. They have a car service too on which they make us visit the full park.
title: Excellent

body: A super peaceful place to visit with lovely gardens, flowers and borders, A stunning palm line walk. The orchid house is simply beautiful and well worth the visit. The entrance is over a long narrow metal bridge that moves !! So maybe not for those who don`t like heights over water etc !! Also has a lovely cafe to stop for a coffee and just watch
title: A really lovely peaceful place to visit

body: Take 2 or 3 hours to enjoy this amazing garden of 60 hectares and up to4000 cultivated species, with an beautiful orquidary to check different ones, and trees full of bats. Also there is a suspended bridge to cross the river and take some photos. It's a peaceful place to be with family and friends and breathe fresh air, after crazy tuk tuk traffic. There is a cafe and restaurant inside the garden to stop and eat something, but you can take something with you. The souvenirs shop is good and not that expensive. I really enjoyed this place!
title: A must go in Kandy

body: 1500Rs to enter each, worth every penny! Simply beautiful just to walk around, the ground keeping is impressive! 1000s of different trees to have to look at! The orchard house is a must visit aswell! Breathtaking three hours spent exploring these amazing gardens! Please note that some of the toilets in the grounds are not traditional toilets and ladies may have to hover over the hole in the floor!
title: Beautiful Gardens!

body: This is a nice and relaxing way to spend a few hours away from the city. The gardens are well maintained, and you can plan your route with the map provided if you have limited time to visit the sections of the gardens which will be of interest to you. Watch out for the aggressive monkeys. One of them snatched a bag I was carrying. They are after food and will approach you. Be careful and put away your possessions.
title: Beautiful Gardens - be careful of the aggressive monkeys!

body: Very beautiful place to visit.Even children can enjoy, it's better to take cart and water if visiting with children as you have to walk a long distance.Orchid garden worth visiting.
title: Beautifully maintained

body: We spent an afternoon here while in Kandy.We started with lunch at the restaurant inside the gardens – where we took the buffet at LKR 800 per person. Sri Lankan food and just what we needed before walking through the gardens.We started from the big Java tree on the Great Lawn. Then browsed through the Palm Avenues and just admired the impressive flora. We went though a bunch of trees with (without exaggeration) hundreds of bats hanging from the branches. Crossed the bridge, admired the orchids and the Giant Bamboo.And then at the exit, we had coconuts while waiting for the rain to stop :)Impressive and relaxing - especially for the children
title: relaxing time away from Kandy

body: There are two entrances - don't go to the main entrance, the entry from the opposite side is much better - quieter and opens up onto the glorious vista with huge fruit bats moving through the trees.Tea or lunch in the cafe is a real tonic after walking around the many aspects to the garden. Great place to take a book and read: its got fresh air, no hassling touts and many quiet spots.
title: The best place in Sri Lanka - history, beautiful fruit bats and charming locals chillin

body: Spread over a large area the botanical garden is massive and full of greenery. We saw pathways of trees n plants n flowers n whole species of birds. Fun walking around the garden. There are lawns to relax n breathe in the fresh air with nature. Many species of orchids are put up in the nursery.its a treat to the soul n senses of our body. There is a hanging bridge to walk across the bridge. Was fun walking the narrow swinging bridge n enjoying the sounds of the gushing river across below.
title: Green garden

body: We spent about two hours walking the grounds of the 700+ year old Royal Botanical Gardens with our 3 children. While fairly expensive for foreigners, the grounds are immaculately kept, the orchid room in particular very interesting, and we all got a kick out of the massive and plentiful fruit bats. Would recommend as a 1-3 hour activity.
title: Visting the Royal Botanical Gardens with kids

body: Was a lovely place to walk around in, plenty of places with shade if the sun was too hot. Something definitely to do in Candy if you have time. Great place to spot monkeys who are not phased by you at all! Lovely bridge with views to walk over. You do as a tourist have to pay to get into the park but if you love nature and have some time to kill it’s worth it
title: Great Place to spot Monkeys!

body: Public Parks and gardens are accessible to the public for free where I come from, so the entry free of 1500 rupees is too much from my perspective. However, the garden is quite interesting for a 2-3 hour stroll.
title: Old and Stately garden

body: What a massive oasis in the middle of such a busy world outside the perimeter.What beautifully kept gardens which are a credit to the staff who look after it.Off-putting is the significant price difference for entry between tourists and locals. Significant price difference!However that being said it was wonderful as always to see monkeys at play.It was wonderful to see such a different variety of grass.The ancient bamboo was a sight to behold as was the massive trees which my children loved climbing.Canon ball trees are amazing and so is the orchid garden and the cactus display and and and ...Price aside it is well worth spending a few hours here ... a place for introverts to rejoice!
title: A Country Full of Unique Surprises & Adventures - Even In Botanical Gardens
Great Bamboo Display.
body: We walked 5.5 klm around this great gardens. It has the best display of Clumping Bamboo I have seen. The Orchid display is very nice, with some so colorful they almost look artificial but they are not. The Teahouse served up Delicious BOPF Grade Tea. A very strong Black which is just perfect. You will see a large family of Monkeys along the way. A huge colony of Flying Foxes (Bats) are destroying a portion of the 150 acres. They need to stay on top of this pest.

title: The Best Garden In Sri Lanka
body: I fell in love when entering this garden!The ambiance was so amazing, the greenery was everywhere coupled with the brilliant weather in the morning that made my coffee and croissant a kind of gift to this wonderful life.We explored every corner of this garden for which I must say they were well treated. I always remember when sitting in the middle of the garden while sunbathing for the morning sunlight, it was really a great experience.I will be back!This visit was back in October 2010)

title: Beautiful Garden (Well Maintained)
body: This is basically and old garden that has been beautifully maintained . I think it was developed by the Britishers . Entry to the park is through a ticket at the main entrance of the park. once you are inside there are different variants of plants and trees , lots of lush green lawns. Inside the garden there is also a cafe . The cafe has got some of the delicious sandwiches and ice teas .Plus the cafe is also not that much expensive. Inside the park there is also a an artifacts shop called Luksala . If you are person who loves nature and a little bit of tranquility then this is the right place .

title: Beautiful place in the heart of Kandy !
body: Nice grounds and serene and peaceful place to spend a couple of hours doing nothing. Small Orchid Garden is beautiful. We saw a couple of snakes near the large Banyan trees ! Very well maintained Gardens and Lawns. Only one coffee shop inside and no real snack options. The souvenir shop at the gate is also nice with a lot of Made In SL stuff rather than the usual Chinese nonsense. Overall an afternoon well spent. Tip : Enter from the back gate which has the rope and metal bridge..and then exit from the main gate.

title: Royal botanical garden
body: This is an old heritage garden . This is a treat for botany lovers. Historic in terms of time and collection

title: Beautifull experience and a fantastic lay out
body: Do not miss this opportunity eventhough you are not into botanic ... it is a wonderfull place to visit and very relaxing ..... we took our time just to stroll around and saw orchids, spices, bamboo, variety of palm trees etc etc. fantastic.....

title: Historical royal garden in Sri Lanka
body: One of the five botanical gardens of Sri Lanka. Largest by area. Also the oldest. This area was used as the royal garden of Kandyan kings in the 18th century. Later, British government converted it to a botanical garden. Remarkably, the garden is surrounded by Mahaweli River by three sides. A fine place for nature lovers. A variety of collection of trees, flowers etc. Well maintained. Nice and calm.Access is very easy. Colombo - Kandy main road. Near Galaha junction. Public transport - Buses starting from Kandy run on this road.Need at least 2-3 hours to explore the place. May required more to observe everything. To see flowers, go to right hand side branch. Otherwise, the left hand side branch gives a true green experience.Good for spending time with family, friends, couples or even solo trips. There are monkeys. Don't feed them. Just watch their behavior. In rainy days, you need an umbrella. There are few huts as shelter. But they won't be sufficient for many people.Plenty of parking available. Vehicle are permitted inside with a fee. Cafeteria is available. Good condition. Non-commercial photography is free of charge.Don't forget to see the view of Hanthana mountain range from the garden.

title: Well maintained Botanical Garden.
body: A Wow for this botanical garden. Its quite a vast place and in summer going thro the vast place is a bit slower but still a MUST VISIT place. Wonderful trees and flora. You can have a buggy ride but should not be opted. The walk through the garden was good and fulfilling. Most of the trees and flowers are marked. Chirping birds and the luxurious spread of greenery is a welcome change.

title: Beautiful gardens!
body: This is a vast garden in Kandy, and will require at least 2 hours if not more to explore. It is a good place to go if you enjoy seeing flowers. they have an orchid conservatory filled with many types of orchids. There is also a lake, a suspension bridge (which actually felt a little dangerous to walk over!) and watch out for the area with 100s of bats on the trees!

title: Impressive gardens
body: Travelling through Kandy, we managed to fit in a couple of hours here. It was pouring with rain at first and fortunately we had hired a buggy which came with a very knowledgeable driver who gave us a great tour. Extensive range of palms , trees , bamboos and other exotica with both formal and informal displays. Some of the trees had the most incredible shapes and were from around the globe. Loved the orchid house with its extensive range of orchids. An oasis of beauty well worth visiting amids5t the bustle of Kandy
